title: A diverse portfolio of marine protected areas can better advance global conservation and equity
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Science 121 (2024)
abstract: Marine protected areas (MPAs) are widely used for ocean conservation, yet the relative impacts of various types of MPAs are poorly understood. We estimated impacts on fish biomass from no-take and multiple-use (fished) MPAs, employing a rigorous matched counterfactual design with a global dataset of >14,000 surveys in and around 216 MPAs. Both no-take and multiple-use MPAs generated positive conservation outcomes relative to no protection (58.2% and 12.6% fish biomass increases, respectively), with smaller estimated differences between the two MPA types when controlling for additional confounding factors (8.3% increase). Relative performance depended on context and management: no-take MPAs performed better in areas of high human pressure but similar to multiple-use in remote locations. Multiple-use MPA performance was low in high-pressure areas but improved significantly with better management, producing similar outcomes to no-take MPAs when adequately staffed and appropriate use regulations were applied. For priority conservation areas where no-take restrictions are not possible or ethical, our findings show that a portfolio of well-designed and well-managed multiple-use MPAs represents a viable and potentially equitable pathway to advance local and global conservation.
abstract_zh: 海洋保护区（MPAs）被广泛用于海洋保护，但不同类型海洋保护区的相对影响尚不清楚。我们采用严格的匹配反事实设计，利用覆盖216个海洋保护区及其周边、超过14,000次调查的全球数据集，估计禁渔型与多用途（允许捕捞）型海洋保护区对鱼类生物量的影响。相对于无保护状态，禁渔型和多用途海洋保护区均产生了正向的保护成效（鱼类生物量分别增加58.2%和12.6%）；在控制其他混杂因素后，两类保护区之间的差异较小（增加8.3%）。相对绩效取决于情境与管理：禁渔型保护区在人类压力大的地区表现更好，而在偏远地区则与多用途保护区相近。多用途保护区在高压力地区表现较低，但随着管理改善而显著提升；当配备充足人员并实施适当的使用规定时，其结果与禁渔型保护区相似。对于不可能或不合伦理实施禁渔限制的优先保护区，我们的研究表明，一组设计良好、管理得当的多用途海洋保护区，是推进地方与全球保护并兼顾公平的可行且可能公平的路径。

title: Tackling debt, biodiversity loss, and climate change
abstract: A “Task Force on Sustainability-Linked Sovereign Financing for Nature and Climate” will convene to establish a framework to ameliorate the debt, biodiversity, and climate crises by reforming debt-for-nature swaps, i.e., voluntary transactions in which creditors reduce or cancel debt in exchange for debtor-country commitments to fund specific environmental activities. We identify four reforms that should underpin the new framework: (i) Offer debt relief at a nationally consequential scale; (ii) defer to debtors on implementation to reduce transaction costs and raise debtors’ benefits; (iii) employ performance-linked instruments based on reliable metrics to ensure global gains; and (iv) integrate all of those metrics across biodiversity conservation, emissions reduction, and climate adaptation to allocate funds most efficiently.
abstract_zh: “自然与气候可持续性挂钩主权融资”特别工作组将召开会议，以建立一个框架，通过改革自然换债（debt-for-nature swaps）来缓解债务、生物多样性和气候危机。自然换债是指债权人自愿减免或注销债务，以换取债务国承诺资助特定环境活动的交易。我们提出，新框架应以四项改革为基础：(i)提供具有全国重大意义规模的债务减免；(ii)将实施权交由债务国，以降低交易成本并提高债务国收益；(iii)采用基于可靠指标的绩效挂钩工具，以确保全球收益；(iv)整合生物多样性保护、减排和气候适应等所有这些指标，以最有效地分配资金。

title: Forest Concessions and Eco-Certifications in the Peruvian Amazon: deforestation impacts of logging rights and logging restrictions
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management 118 (2023)
abstract: Concessions that grant logging rights to firms support economic development, based on forest resources. Eco-certifications place sustainability restrictions on the operation of such logging concessions. Using a spatially detailed panel and new DID estimators, we estimate the 2002-2018 impacts on forests in the Peruvian Amazon of both logging concessions and eco-certifications. We find that concessions — which have ambiguous priors —did not raise forest loss and, if anything, reduced it slightly by warding off temporary rises in external deforestation. While eco-certifications could reduce forest loss, we find no significant impact.
abstract_zh: 授予企业伐木权的特许经营，以森林资源为基础支持经济发展。生态认证对此类伐木特许经营的运营施加可持续性限制。利用空间细化的面板数据和新的DID估计量，我们估计了2002–2018年伐木特许经营与生态认证对秘鲁亚马逊森林的影响。我们发现，特许经营（其事前影响方向并不确定）并未增加森林损失，若有影响，还略微减少了森林损失，因为它遏制了外部砍伐在短期内的临时增加。虽然生态认证可能减少森林损失，但我们未发现显著影响。

title: No crowding out among those terminated from an ongoing PES program in Colombia
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management 120 (2023)
abstract: This paper presents novel evidence of no crowding out, of either motivations or donations, among those terminated from an ongoing program of payments for ecosystem services (PES) in Colombia. PES programs have risen in number. However, claims about perverse impacts after programs end could inhibit their growth. PES end for different reasons (planned duration, budget reduction, issues in implementation) and in different ways (some participants or all). An expressed concern for PES is that receiving payments lowers conservation, after PES end, if participants' intrinsic motivations for conservation are ‘crowded out’ by financial incentives. We test for crowding out by an ongoing program in which some but not all contracts were terminated. We see no evidence of crowding out, since neither the motivations nor the donations for the terminated farmers are significantly different than for non-PES land owners (and this is robust to matching on levels of assets, residence on farm past donation behavior, main economic activity, and participation in collective activities). Our results add evidence from an actual PES to literature questioning the relevance, importance and even sign of crowding effects.
abstract_zh: 本文提供了新的证据，表明在哥伦比亚一项仍在进行的生态系统服务付费（PES）项目中，被终止合同的人员在动机和捐赠方面均不存在挤出效应。PES项目数量不断增加。然而，关于项目结束后产生反向影响的说法可能会阻碍其发展。PES的终止原因各异（计划期限、预算削减、执行问题），终止方式也不同（部分参与者或全部参与者）。人们对PES的一个担忧是：如果参与者的保护内在动机被经济激励“挤出”，那么在PES结束后，接受付款可能会降低保护水平。我们通过一个仍在进行、但部分（而非全部）合同被终止的项目来检验挤出效应。我们未发现挤出效应的证据：被终止农户的动机和捐赠，与非PES土地所有者相比均无显著差异（在按资产水平、住所位于农场、过去的捐赠行为、主要经济活动以及参与集体活动进行匹配后，结果依然稳健）。我们的结果为质疑挤出效应的相关性、重要性乃至方向的文献，提供了来自实际PES项目的证据。

title: Temporary PES do not crowd out and may crowd in lab-in-the-field forest conservation in Colombia
abstract: Payments for ecosystem services (PES) programs exist globally and at times shift behaviors. Unlike protected areas, PES compensate land users, raising local acceptance of conservation. Yet some worry that if payments are temporary, as is often the case, conservation behaviors can be reduced by PES, ‘crowded out’ to be lower after PES than if no PES had existed. We conducted lab-in-the-field experiments in Colombia, where PES policies are expanding, offering either individual or collective conditional payments to 676 farmers who are potential PES participants. Those payments end, within each experimental session, for all or only for some participants. We consistently find that conservation is not lower after PES than before. Also, conservation contributions tend to fall over time without PES, in keeping with public-goods literatures. Taken together, these results imply that even after our payments end, conservation is above the baseline defined by our controls, suggesting some form of (at least short-run) crowding in.
abstract_zh: 生态系统服务付费（PES）项目在全球范围内存在，且有时会改变行为。与保护区不同，PES补偿土地使用者，从而提高当地对保护的接受度。然而，有人担心：如果支付是临时的（这在实践中很常见），PES可能导致保护行为减少，即出现“挤出”，使PES结束后的保护水平低于从未实施PES时的水平。我们在哥伦比亚开展了田野实验室（lab-in-the-field）实验，该国PES政策正在扩大。我们向676名潜在PES参与农户提供个人或集体的有条件支付。在每场实验中，这些支付对全部或仅部分参与者结束。我们始终发现，PES结束后的保护水平并不低于之前。此外，在没有PES的情况下，保护贡献往往随时间下降，这与公共物品文献的结论一致。综合来看，这些结果表明，即使我们的支付结束后，保护水平仍高于对照组所确定的基线，这暗示着某种（至少是短期的）挤入效应。

title: Does the Selective Erasure of Protected Areas Raise Deforestation in the Brazilian Amazon?
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists (2022)
abstract: Protected areas (PAs) are the leading policy to lower deforestation. Yet resistance by land users leads PAs to be created in remote sites, lowering impact. Resistance continues after PA creation, with both illegal deforestation and advocacy for PADDD, that is, reducing PA status (downgrading) or PA size (partial or full erasure, downsizing or degazettement). For the Brazilian Amazon, we estimate 2010–15 forest impacts of 2009–12 PA erasures, on average and for distinct states. Before panel-DID regression, to find similar controls we matched using static characteristics and 8–10 years of pretreatment deforestation. PA erasures should raise deforestation if erased PAs faced and blocked pressures. Consistent with this, three conditions for “environmental selection” yielded little short-run impact from PADDD: low pressures, unblocked higher pressures, and pressures blocked less by those PAs selected for erasures. Yet for “development selection,” with PA erasures in sites with pressures plus enforcement, PADDD yielded increased deforestation.
abstract_zh: 保护区（PAs）是减少森林砍伐的主要政策。然而，土地使用者的抵制导致保护区多设于偏远地区，从而降低了其影响。保护区设立之后，抵制仍在继续，表现为非法砍伐以及倡导PADDD，即降低保护区地位（降级）或缩小保护区面积（部分或全部“抹除”，即缩减或撤销）。针对巴西亚马逊地区，我们估计了2009–2012年保护区抹除在2010–2015年间造成的森林影响，既包括平均影响，也包括各州的分别影响。在进行面板双重差分回归之前，为寻找相似的对照组，我们使用静态特征和8–10年的处理前砍伐数据进行了匹配。若被抹除的保护区面临并受阻于压力，PA抹除应会增加砍伐。与此一致，“环境选择”的三个条件所导致的PADDD短期影响很小：压力较低、未受阻的较高压力，以及这些被选定进行抹除的保护区所受阻的压力较小。然而，对于“发展选择”——即在既存在开发压力又有执法行动的地点进行保护区抹除——PADDD则导致了砍伐增加。

title: Environmental Policies Benefit Economic Development: Implications of Economic Geography
abstract: For over a century, starting with the work of Alfred Marshall (and also in resource economics), economic geography has emphasized the productivity of dense urban agglomerations. Yet little attention is paid to one key policy implication of economic geography's core mechanisms: Environmental policies can aid economic development, per se—not hurting the economy to help the environment but advancing both objectives. We review mechanisms from economic geography that imply that environmental policies can deliver such win-wins: influences upon agglomeration of long-standing natural conditions, like usable bays, which long were perceived as fixed yet now are being shifted by global environmental quality; agglomeration's effects on other influential conditions, like urban environmental quality; and the effects of rural environmental quality on the flows to cities of people and environmental quality. Finally, we consider a geographic policy typology in asking why society leaves money on the table by failing to promote environmental policies despite the potential win-wins that we highlight.
abstract_zh: 一个多世纪以来，自阿尔弗雷德·马歇尔的研究开始（资源经济学中亦然），经济地理学一直强调密集城市集聚的生产率。然而，人们很少关注经济地理学核心机制所蕴含的一个关键政策含义：环境政策本身可以促进经济发展——不是为了环境而损害经济，而是同时推进两个目标。我们梳理了经济地理学中的相关机制，这些机制表明环境政策可以带来双赢：长期以来被视为固定不变、但如今正被全球环境质量改变的自然条件（如可用的海湾）对集聚的影响；集聚对其他重要条件（如城市环境质量）的影响；以及农村环境质量对人口和环境质量向城市流动的影响。最后，我们从地理政策类型学的角度提问：尽管存在我们所强调的双赢潜力，社会为何仍会因未能推动环境政策而白白放弃收益。

title: Can we increase the impacts from payments for ecosystem services? Impact rose over time in Costa Rica, yet spatial variation indicates more potential
abstract: As programs with payments for ecosystem services (PES) have become more numerous, raising the need for and also the opportunity for rigorous evidence on their contributions, we examine shifts within Costa Rica’s Pagos por Servicios Ambientales (PSA) program. The PSA was heralded from its initiation, despite demonstrations of low early impacts. We study shifts in impact over time across early periods and whether further adjustments could raise contributions. Looking over time, we find that PSA contracts signed for the 2000–2005 period had higher impacts than contracts for the program’s initial time period, 1997–1999 found in previous research. Looking over space, we find that PSA payments have higher impacts for lower slopes and lower market distances. Linking these results, the rise in impact for 2000–2005 occurred alongside a shift in the targeting of PSA, which was along ecological dimensions (limiting effects of owners offering unprofitable lands). Yet the spatial variations in impacts we document suggest that explicitly targeting impact offers the potential to further raise PES impacts in Costa Rica, as well as in other nations.
abstract_zh: 随着生态系统服务付费（PES）项目日益增多，对其贡献进行严格证据评估的需求和机会也随之增加，我们考察了哥斯达黎加“环境服务支付”（Pagos por Servicios Ambientales，PSA）项目内部的变化。该项目自启动起就备受推崇，尽管早期已有证据表明其影响较低。我们研究了不同早期时期影响的变化，以及进一步调整能否提高其贡献。纵向来看，我们发现，2000–2005年期间签订的PSA合同，其影响高于先前研究中发现的项目初始时期（1997–1999年）的合同。横向来看，我们发现PSA支付在坡度较低、与市场距离较近的地区影响更大。综合这些结果，2000–2005年影响的上升与PSA瞄准对象的转变同时发生，这种瞄准是基于生态维度的（限制了提供无利可图土地的所有者的影响）。然而，我们记录的空间差异表明，明确以影响为导向进行瞄准，有可能进一步提高哥斯达黎加乃至其他国家PES的影响。

title: Election cycles affect deforestation within Brazil’s Atlantic Forest
abstract: Policymakers’ incentives during election campaigns can lead to decisions that significantly affect deforestation. Yet this is rarely studied. For Brazil's Atlantic Forest, a highly biodiverse tropical forest, we link federal‐and‐state as well as municipal elections to annual deforestation between 1991 and 2014. Across 2253 municipalities, those with higher deforestation see a significant rise in deforestation during federal‐and‐state election years. Municipal election years raise deforestation for locations with lower deforestation, whereas all of these increases are accentuated when there is party alignment between different levels of government. This effect of election cycles has fallen over time, to date, yet that cannot be assumed to continue. Our results highlight the need to limit opportunistic behaviors that affect natural resources and the environment with implications for biodiversity, carbon storage, and other ecosystem services.
abstract_zh: 政策制定者在竞选期间的激励，可能导致对森林砍伐产生重大影响的决策，但这一问题鲜有研究。以高度生物多样性的热带森林——巴西大西洋森林为对象，我们将联邦与州层面的选举以及市级选举，与1991至2014年间的年度森林砍伐数据联系起来。在2253个市镇中，原本森林砍伐较多的地区在联邦与州选举年份中，森林砍伐出现显著上升。市级选举年份则会使森林砍伐较少地区的砍伐量增加，而当不同层级政府之间存在政党一致性时，所有这些增幅都会被放大。选举周期的这一效应随时间推移已有所减弱，但不能假定这一趋势会持续下去。我们的结果凸显了限制机会主义行为的必要性，这类行为会影响自然资源与环境，并对生物多样性、碳储存及其他生态系统服务产生影响。

title: Leaders’ distributional & efficiency effects in collective responses to policy: Lab-in-field experiments with small-scale gold miners in Colombia
abstract: Globally, small-scale gold mining (SSGM) is an important economic option for many rural poor. It involves local uses of shared resources, like common-pool contexts for which self-governance has avoided ‘tragedies of the commons’. Yet even ideal local governance of SSGM is not societally efficient given non-local damages that suggest external interventions for desired shifts. Because transactions costs are high for rewarding reductions in damages on remote mining frontiers, states could gain if rewards based on low-cost, group compliance measures could successfully induce cooperation in response to policy. However, as group-level rewards invite free-riding, such success requires local collective action. Since that guarantees neither efficient coordination nor equitable distributions of net benefits from compliance, we consider the impacts of emergent leaders on local responses to external policy. We employ framed lab experiments with 200 small-scale gold miners in Colombia's Pacific to explore leaders’ impacts on equity and efficiency in collective responses to external incentives. Allowing communication before individual choice, which raises efficiency but not always equity, we can identify emergent leaders of groups’ communications. Leaders raise compliance and affect how its costs are distributed, suggesting access to leadership roles matters.
abstract_zh: 全球范围内，小规模金矿开采（SSGM）是许多农村贫困人口重要的经济选择。它涉及对共享资源的本地利用，类似于公共池塘情境，而自我治理在此类情境中避免了“公地悲剧”。然而，即使对SSGM实施理想的本地治理，考虑到非本地损害，其在社会层面也并非有效率，这就需要外部干预以实现期望的转变。由于在偏远采矿前沿地区奖励减少损害的交易成本很高，若基于低成本的群体合规测量的奖励能够成功诱导政策响应下的合作，国家将可获益。然而，由于群体层面的奖励会引发搭便车，这种成功需要本地集体行动。由于集体行动既不能保证有效协调，也不能保证合规所带来净收益的公平分配，我们考察了涌现的领导者对本地应对外部政策的影响。我们在哥伦比亚太平洋地区，对200名小规模金矿工人进行了框架化的实验室实验，以探究领导者如何影响集体应对外部激励时的公平与效率。我们允许在个人选择前进行沟通，这能提高效率但未必改善公平，由此我们可以识别出在群体沟通中自发涌现的领导者。领导者提高了合规水平，并影响了合规成本的分配，这表明获得领导职位的机会至关重要。

title: The Brazilian intergovernmental fiscal transfer for conservation: a successful but self-limiting incentive program
abstract: Brazil’s ecological intergovernmental fiscal transfer (ICMS-E) is a conservation incentive for protected areas (PAs). It redistributes tax revenues to reward municipalities for hosting PAs. To quantify its impact on the creation of state and municipal PAs, we used panel regressions on a longitudinal municipality dataset that combined information on PA creation and ICMS-E implementation for the 1467 municipalities in 6 Brazilian states in the Atlantic Forest region that never changed borders, from 1987 to 2016. We found that the percent of the municipal area covered with state or municipal PAs increased as a consequence of ICMS-E implementation. However, the magnitude of this effect declined as the ICMS-E revenue is shared more widely due to the expansion of PAs that reduced the gain from new PAs. We also found that ICMS-E policy primarily spurred the creation of PAs with less restrictive rules – similar to IUCN category V reserves – mainly by municipalities. For more restrictive PAs with higher local costs for municipalities, ICMS-E promoted state-proposed PAs but not municipal PAs. Our results suggest that states used ICMS-E to incentivize local implementation of their conservation preferences, including strict conservation, while municipal governments responded mostly with low-cost actions to increase their revenues.
abstract_zh: 巴西的生态政府间财政转移支付（ICMS-E）是一项针对保护区（PAs）的保护激励措施。它通过再分配税收收入，奖励承载保护区的市镇。为量化其对州级与市级保护区设立的影响，我们使用一个纵向市镇数据集进行面板回归，该数据集结合了1987至2016年间巴西大西洋森林地区6个州中、边界从未变动的1467个市镇的保护区设立与ICMS-E实施信息。我们发现，州或市保护区所覆盖的市域面积比例因ICMS-E的实施而增加。然而，随着ICMS-E收入因保护区扩张而被更广泛地分享，这一效应的幅度有所下降，因为新设保护区带来的收益被削弱了。我们还发现，ICMS-E政策主要促进了限制较少的保护区的设立（类似于IUCN V类保护地），且主要由市镇推动。对于限制较严、对市镇地方成本较高的保护区，ICMS-E促进了州提议设立的保护区，而非市级保护区。我们的结果表明，各州利用ICMS-E激励地方落实其保护偏好（包括严格保护），而市政府则主要以低成本行动来增加收入。

title: Evaluating REDD+ at Subnational Level: Amazon Fund impacts in Alta Floresta, Brazil
abstract: The Amazon Fund is the world’s largest program to reduce emissions from deforestation and forest degradation (REDD+), funded with over US $1b donated by Norway and Germany between 2008 and 2017 to reward Brazil for prior deforestation reductions. Olhos D’Água da Amazônia is cited as a leading project success − with over one thousand small-to-medium-sized crop and livestock producers in the municipality of Alta Floresta, Mato Grosso State receiving more from the Amazon Fund than all but two other municipalities. To secure property rights, aid environmental planning, and raise farmers’ productivity and output diversity, the project helped farmers register in Brazil’s environmental cadaster and receive property certificates. Furthermore, Olhos D’Água supported milk and honey production and paid farmers to conserve riverine forest sites. We estimate causal effects of Olhos D’Água, versus a counterfactual estimate of what would have happened without the project, using a synthetic-control method. We build from the pool of blacklisted municipalities weighted averages (synthetic controls) that best match pre-treatment outcomes for Alta Floresta. Project effects are estimated as post-treatment differences between Alta Floresta and the synthetic controls. We find that the project increased new CAR registrations, and INCRA certifications, and may have moderately increased honey and milk production. Alta Floresta’s annual forest losses remained historically low but we find no clear causal effect of the project on deforestation rates. Our results support that rigorous impact evaluation can motivate and guide project improvements.
abstract_zh: 亚马逊基金是全球规模最大的减少毁林与森林退化所致排放（REDD+）项目，由挪威和德国在2008至2017年间捐助超过10亿美元，用以奖励巴西此前减少毁林的成效。Olhos D’Água da Amazônia被视为领先的项目成功案例：马托格罗索州阿尔塔弗洛雷斯塔市超过一千名中小型作物与畜牧生产者从亚马逊基金获得的资金，超过了除另外两个市镇以外的所有市镇。为确保产权、辅助环境规划，并提高农户生产率与产出多样性，该项目帮助农户在巴西环境登记簿中登记，并获得产权证书。此外，Olhos D’Água还支持了牛奶和蜂蜜生产，并向农户支付费用以保护河岸森林地块。我们采用合成控制方法，估计Olhos D’Água项目的因果效应，并与无该项目时可能发生情况的反事实估计进行比较。我们从被列入黑名单的市镇中构建加权平均值（合成控制），使其与阿尔塔弗洛雷斯塔在处理前的结果最为吻合。项目效应被估计为处理后阿尔塔弗洛雷斯塔与合成控制之间的差异。我们发现，该项目增加了新的CAR登记和INCRA认证，并可能适度提高了蜂蜜和牛奶产量。阿尔塔弗洛雷斯塔的年度森林损失仍处于历史低位，但我们未发现该项目对毁林率有明确的因果效应。我们的结果表明，严格的影响评估能够推动并指导项目改进。

title: Investing in local capacity to respond to a federal environmental mandate: forest & economic impacts of the Green Municipality Program in the Brazilian Amazon
abstract: Over the past decade, the Brazilian federal government has offered a negative collective incentive to reduce deforestation by ‘blacklisting’ the municipalities in the Amazon with the highest deforestation rates. As for any unfunded mandate, the responses to blacklisting depend on both local incentives and local capacities. We evaluate a state program − Programa Municípios Verdes (PMV) or the Green Municipality Program – to increase the capacity of municipal governments in the state of Pará to respond to this federal incentive. The PMV is voluntary, as municipal governments choose whether to participate. To control for differences due to self-selection into the program, we employ quasi-experimental methods: two-way, fixed-effects regressions in matched samples of municipalities; and the synthetic control method that compares outcomes in a participating municipality to outcomes in a weighted blend of control municipalities. Neither approach suggests that the PMV reduced deforestation beyond the effect of the blacklist. We hypothesize that municipalities joined the PMV to ameliorate the costs of complying with blacklist requirements, including the costs of exiting the blacklist. We show that the PMV increased total value added – with substantial heterogeneity - in participating blacklisted municipalities, and that these gains likely are not due to agricultural intensification. They may result from reductions in compliance risk and cost that make economic investments in a municipality more appealing. In the long run, this could make forest conservation more socially and politically sustainable.
abstract_zh: 过去十年间，巴西联邦政府对亚马逊地区砍伐率最高的市镇实施“黑名单”制度，以此提供一种负向集体激励，促使其减少毁林。与任何无资金支持的强制性任务一样，对黑名单的反应既取决于地方激励，也取决于地方能力。我们评估了一项州级项目——Programa Municípios Verdes（PMV），即绿色市镇计划——旨在提升帕拉州市级政府应对这一联邦激励的能力。PMV是自愿性的，市级政府可自行选择是否参与。为控制因自选择参与项目而产生的差异，我们采用准实验方法：在匹配样本市镇中进行双向固定效应回归，以及合成控制方法，将参与市镇的结果与控制市镇的加权组合进行比较。两种方法均表明，PMV并未在黑名单效应之外进一步减少毁林。我们推测，市镇加入PMV是为了减轻遵守黑名单要求的成本，包括退出黑名单的成本。我们表明，PMV增加了总增加值（在参与的被列入黑名单的市镇中存在显著异质性），而且这些收益很可能并非源于农业集约化。它们可能源于合规风险与成本的降低，从而使市镇内的经济投资更具吸引力。从长远看，这可能使森林保护在社会与政治上更具可持续性。

title: The Effectiveness of Forest Conservation Policies and Programs
abstract: The world's forests provide valuable contributions to people but continue to be threatened by agricultural expansion and other land uses. Counterfactual-based methods are increasingly used to evaluate forest conservation initiatives. This review synthesizes recent studies quantifying the impacts of such policies and programs. Extending past reviews focused on instrument choice, design, and implementation, our theory of change explicitly acknowledges context. Screening over 60,000 abstracts yielded 136 comparable normalized effect sizes (Cohen's d). Comparing across instrument categories, evaluation methods, and contexts suggests not only a lack of “silver bullets” in the conservation toolbox, but that effectiveness is also moderate on average. Yet context is critical. Many interventions in our sample were implemented in “bullet-proof” contexts of low pressure on natural resources. This greatly limits their potential impacts and suggests the need to invest further not only in understanding but also in better aligning conservation with local and global development goals.
abstract_zh: 世界森林为人类提供了宝贵的贡献，但仍受到农业扩张及其他土地利用的威胁。基于反事实的方法越来越多地被用于评估森林保护举措。本综述综合了近期量化此类政策与项目影响的研究。在过去关于工具选择、设计与实施的综述基础上，我们的变革理论明确承认情境的重要性。在筛选了60,000多篇摘要后，我们得到136个可比较的标准化效应量（Cohen's d）。比较不同工具类别、评估方法与情境后表明，保护工具箱中不仅缺乏“银弹”，而且有效性平均而言也较为温和。然而，情境至关重要。我们样本中的许多干预措施是在对自然资源压力较低的“防弹型”情境中实施的。这极大地限制了它们的潜在影响，并表明需要进一步投资，不仅要理解保护，还要更好地使保护与地方和全球发展目标相协调。

title: What Drives the Erasure of Protected Areas? Evidence from across the Brazilian Amazon
abstract: Protected areas (PAs) are a widely used strategy for conserving forests and ecosystem services. When PAs succeed in deterring economic activities that degrade forests, the impacts include more forest yet less economic gain. These economic opportunity costs of conservation lead actors with economic interests to resist new PAs, driving their sites away from profitable market centers and towards areas featuring lower opportunity costs. Further, after PAs are created, economic actors may want PA downgrading, downsizing, and degazettement (collectively PADDD). We examine reductions in PAs’ spatial extent – downsizings (partial erasures) and degazettements (complete erasures) − that presumably reduce protection. Using data for the entire Brazilian Amazon from PADDDtracker.org, our empirical analyses explore whether size reductions from 2006 to 2015 resulted from bargaining between development and conservation. We find that the risks of PA size reductions are raised by: lower travel costs (as implied by distances to roads and cities), which affect economic gains and enforcement; greater PA size, which affects enforcement; and more prior internal deforestation, which lowers the impacts of size reductions. These dynamics of protection offer insights on the potentially conflicting factors that lead to PA size reductions, with implications for policymaking to enhance PA effectiveness and permanence.
abstract_zh: 保护区（PAs）是保护森林与生态系统服务的一项广泛使用的策略。当保护区成功阻止破坏森林的经济活动时，其影响包括森林增加，但经济收益减少。这些保护的经济机会成本使有经济利益的行为体抵制新设保护区，并将其选址推向远离有利可图的市场中心、转向机会成本较低的地区。此外，保护区设立之后，经济行为体可能希望进行PADDD（降级、缩减与撤销的统称）。我们考察了保护区空间范围的缩减，即缩减（部分抹除）和撤销（完全抹除），这些被认为会削弱保护。利用来自PADDDtracker.org的整个巴西亚马逊地区数据，我们的实证分析探讨了2006至2015年间的面积缩减是否源于发展与保护之间的博弈。我们发现，以下因素会提高保护区面积缩减的风险：较低的交通成本（以到公路和城市的距离衡量），这影响经济收益与执法；保护区面积较大，这影响执法；以及此前的内部砍伐较多，这会降低面积缩减的影响。这些保护动态为导致保护区面积缩减的潜在冲突因素提供了见解，对提高保护区有效性与持久性的政策制定具有启示意义。

title: Collective Local Payments for Ecosystem Services: new local PES between groups, sanctions, and prior watershed trust in Mexico
abstract: Payments for ecosystem services (PES) programs are now high in number, if not always in impact. When groups of users pay groups of service providers, establishing PES involves collective action. We study the creation of collective PES institutions, and their continuation, as group coordination. We use framed lab-in-field experiments with hydroservices users and providers within watersheds participating in Mexico’s Matching Funds program in Veracruz, Yucatan and Quintana Roo states. We explore the coordination of contributions between downstream users and upstream providers, plus effects of different types of sanctions that can affect expectations for both users and providers. Both information alone and sanctions raise contributions overall, although outcomes varied by site in line with our rankings of ‘watershed trust’. For instance, monetary sanctions raise contributions in the watershed we ranked high in trust, yet initially lowered them for the lowest-trust watershed. This suggests that upstream-downstream social capital will be central to new collective local PES, while our overall trends suggest social capital can be raised by successful coordination over time.
abstract_zh: 生态系统服务付费（PES）项目目前数量众多，但其影响并非总是如此显著。当用户群体向服务提供者群体付费时，建立PES就涉及集体行动。我们将集体PES制度的创建及其持续性视为群体协调问题。我们在墨西哥韦拉克鲁斯、尤卡坦和金塔纳罗奥州参与“配套基金”（Matching Funds）项目的流域中，对水服务使用者与提供者开展了框架化的田野实验室实验。我们考察了下游用户与上游提供者之间缴费的协调，以及可能影响用户与提供者双方预期的不同类型制裁的效果。信息本身与制裁都会总体上提高缴费，尽管结果因地点而异，且与我们对“流域信任度”的排序一致。例如，货币制裁在我们排序为高信任度的流域中提高了缴费，但在信任度最低的流域中起初却降低了缴费。这表明，上下游的社会资本将是新的集体地方PES的核心，而我们总体的趋势表明，社会资本可以通过随时间推移的成功协调而提高。

title: Evaluating the impacts of protected areas on human well-being across the developing world
abstract: Protected areas (PAs) are fundamental for biodiversity conservation, yet their impacts on nearby residents are contested. We synthesized environmental and socioeconomic conditions of >87,000 children in >60,000 households situated either near or far from >600 PAs within 34 developing countries. We used quasi-experimental hierarchical regression to isolate the impact of living near a PA on several aspects of human well-being. Households near PAs with tourism also had higher wealth levels (by 17%) and a lower likelihood of poverty (by 16%) than similar households living far from PAs. Children under 5 years old living near multiple-use PAs with tourism also had higher height-for-age scores (by 10%) and were less likely to be stunted (by 13%) than similar children living far from PAs. For the largest and most comprehensive socioeconomic-environmental dataset yet assembled, we found no evidence of negative PA impacts and consistent statistical evidence to suggest PAs can positively affect human well-being.
abstract_zh: 保护区（PAs）对生物多样性保护至关重要，但其对附近居民的影响存在争议。我们综合了34个发展中国家中600多个保护区附近或远离保护区的60,000多户家庭、87,000多名儿童的环境与社会经济状况。我们使用准实验性的分层回归，分离出居住在保护区附近对人类福祉多个方面的影响。与远离保护区的类似家庭相比，居住在有旅游活动的保护区附近的家庭财富水平也更高（高17%），贫困的可能性也更低（低16%）。与远离保护区的类似儿童相比，居住在有旅游活动的多用途保护区附近的5岁以下儿童，身高别年龄得分也更高（高10%），发育迟缓的可能性也更低（低13%）。对于迄今为止汇编的规模最大、最全面的社会经济—环境数据集，我们没有发现保护区产生负面影响的证据，并且有一致的统计证据表明，保护区能够对人类福祉产生积极影响。

title: Graduated stringency within collective incentives for group environmental compliance: Building coordination in field-lab experiments with artisanal gold miners in Colombia
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management 98
abstract: Small-scale gold mining is important to rural livelihoods in the developing world but also a source of environmental externalities. Incentives for individual producers are the classic policy response for a socially efficient balance between livelihoods and the environment. Yet monitoring individual miners is ineffective, or it is very costly, especially on frontiers with scattered small-scale miners. We ask whether monitoring at a group level effectively incentivizes cleaner artisanal mining by combining lower-cost external monitoring with local collective action. We employ a mining-framed, threshold-public-goods experiment in Colombia’s Pacific region, with 640 participants from frontier mining communities. To study compliance with collective environmental targets, we vary the target stringency, including to compare increases over time in the stringency versus decreases. We find that collective incentives can induce efficient equilibria, with group compliance — and even inefficient overcompliance — despite the existence of equilibria with zero contributions. Yet, for demanding targets in which the reward for compliance barely outweighs the cost, compliance can collapse. Those outcomes improve with past successes for easier targets, however, so our results suggest gain from building coordination via graduated stringency.
abstract_zh: 小规模金矿开采对发展中国家农村生计很重要，但也是环境外部性的来源。针对个体生产者的激励是实现生计与环境之间社会有效平衡的经典政策应对。然而，监测个体矿工效果不佳，或成本非常高，尤其是在小规模矿工分散的前沿地区。我们探讨，群体层面的监测能否通过低成本的外部监测与地方集体行动相结合，有效激励更清洁的手工采矿。我们在哥伦比亚太平洋地区开展了以采矿为框架的阈值公共物品实验，参与者为来自前沿采矿社区的640名参与者。为研究对集体环境目标的遵守情况，我们改变了目标的严格程度，包括比较随时间推移提高严格程度与降低严格程度的情形。我们发现，集体激励能够诱导有效均衡，即使存在零贡献的均衡，群体合规（甚至是低效的过度合规）也会出现。然而，对于那些要求苛刻、以至于合规奖励仅勉强超过成本的目标，合规可能会崩溃。不过，这些结果会随着对较容易目标的过往成功而改善，因此我们的结果表明，通过分级递进的严格程度来建立协调是有益的。

title: Impacts of protected areas vary with the level of government: comparing avoided deforestation across agencies in the Brazilian Amazon
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: As protected areas (PAs) are a leading conservation strategy, understanding what conditions affect their impacts is critical. We expect different government agencies to vary in their PA locations and management. We offer a test of whether PA impacts vary across agencies. For the Brazilian Amazon, we compare deforestation impacts for 3 types of agencies: federal indigenous lands, federal PAs, and state PAs. Across states within the “arc of deforestation,” internal PA impacts are higher for indigenous lands and federal PAs than for state PAs. In Pará State, federal agencies also have spillover impacts: Indigenous lands raise deforestation nearby, and federal PAs lower deforestation nearby. Agencies’ objectives and capacities affect impacts, and thereby are important considerations for implementing international environmental agreements.
abstract_zh: 由于保护区（PAs）是领先的保护策略，理解哪些条件影响其效果至关重要。我们预期，不同政府机构在保护区的选址与管理上会有所不同。我们检验了保护区影响在不同机构之间是否存在差异。针对巴西亚马逊地区，我们比较了三类机构的毁林影响：联邦原住民土地、联邦保护区和州保护区。在“毁林弧”内的各州，内部保护区的影响在原住民土地和联邦保护区中高于州保护区。在帕拉州，联邦机构还具有溢出效应：原住民土地会增加附近的毁林，而联邦保护区则降低附近的毁林。机构的目标与能力会影响其效果，因此，对于执行国际环境协定而言，它们是重要的考量因素。

title: Pervasive human-driven decline of life on Earth points to the need for transformative change
abstract: The human impact on life on Earth has increased sharply since the 1970s, driven by the demands of a growing population with rising average per capita income. Nature is currently supplying more materials than ever before, but this has come at the high cost of unprecedented global declines in the extent and integrity of ecosystems, distinctness of local ecological communities, abundance and number of wild species, and the number of local domesticated varieties. Such changes reduce vital benefits that people receive from nature and threaten the quality of life of future generations. Both the benefits of an expanding economy and the costs of reducing nature's benefits are unequally distributed. The fabric of life on which we all depend-nature and its contributions to people-is unravelling rapidly. Despite the severity of the threats and lack of enough progress in tackling them to date, opportunities exist to change future trajectories through transformative action. Such action must begin immediately, however, and address the root economic, social, and technological causes of nature's deterioration.
abstract_zh: 自20世纪70年代以来，人类对地球生命的影响急剧增加，其驱动力是人口增长以及人均收入上升带来的需求。目前，自然提供的材料比以往任何时候都多，但这是以前所未有的代价换来的：全球生态系统的范围与完整性、当地生态群落的独特性、野生物种的丰度与数量，以及本地驯化品种的数量，都出现了空前的下降。这些变化削弱了人们从自然中获得的重要惠益，并威胁到未来世代的生活质量。经济扩张的收益与自然惠益减少的成本都分配不均。我们所有人赖以生存的生命结构（自然及其对人类的贡献）正在迅速瓦解。尽管威胁严重，且迄今在应对这些威胁方面进展不足，但仍存在通过变革性行动改变未来轨迹的机会。然而，此类行动必须立即开始，并解决导致自然退化的根本经济、社会和技术原因。

title: Reducing Environmental Risks from Belt and Road Initiative Investments in Transportation Infrastructure
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper 8718
abstract: The Belt and Road Initiative, due to its diverse and extensive infrastructure investments, poses a wide range of environmental risks. Some projects have easily identifiable and measurable impacts, such as energy projects'greenhouse gas emissions. Others, such as transportation infrastructure, due to their vast geographic reach, generate more complex and potentially more extensive environmental risks. The proposed Belt and Road Initiative rail and road investments have stimulated concerns because of the history of significant negative environmental impacts from large-scale transportation projects across the globe. This paper studies environmental risks -- direct and indirect -- from Belt and Road Initiative transportation projects and the mitigation strategies and policies to address them. The paper concludes with a recommendation on how to take advantage of the scale of the Belt and Road Initiative to address these concerns in a way not typically available to stand-alone projects. In short, this scale motivates and permits early integrated development and conservation planning.
abstract_zh: 一带一路倡议涉及多样而广泛的基础设施投资，因而带来各种各样的环境风险。一些项目的影响易于识别和衡量，例如能源项目的温室气体排放。其他项目，例如交通基础设施，由于地理覆盖范围广阔，产生的环境风险更为复杂，也可能更加广泛。鉴于全球大规模交通项目过去曾造成严重的负面环境影响，拟议中的“一带一路”铁路与公路投资已引发担忧。本文研究了一带一路交通项目带来的直接和间接环境风险，以及应对这些风险的缓解策略与政策。本文最后就如何利用一带一路的规模来解决这些问题提出建议，这种方式通常是单个独立项目无法获得的。简言之，这一规模推动并允许早期的综合发展与保护规划。

title: Contracts versus Trust for Transfers of Nature’s Services: equity and efficiency in resource allocation and environmental provision
abstract: Managing natural-resource allocation and environmental externalities is a challenge. Institutional designs are central when improving water quality for downstream users, for instance, and when reallocating water quantities including for climate adaptation. Views differ on which institutions are best: states; markets; or informal institutions. For transfers of ecosystem services, we compare informal trust-based institutions to enforced contracts, both being institutional types we observe commonly in the field. The trust-based institutions lack binding promises, thus ecosystem-services suppliers are unsure about the compensation they will receive for transferring services to users. We employ decision experiments given the shortcomings of the alternative methods for empirical study of institutions, as well as the limits on theoretical prediction about behaviors under trust. In our bargaining game that decouples equity and efficiency, we find that enforced contracts increased efficiency as well as all measures of equity. This informs the design of institutions to manage transfers of ecosystem services, as equity in surplus sharing is important in of itself and in permitting efficient allocation.
abstract_zh: 管理自然资源配置与环境外部性是一项挑战。制度设计至关重要，例如在改善下游用户的水质时，以及在重新分配水量（包括用于气候适应）时。关于哪种制度最佳，观点不一：国家、市场，还是非正式制度。对于生态系统服务的转移，我们比较了基于信任的非正式制度与强制执行的合同，这两种制度类型在实践中都很常见。基于信任的制度缺乏具有约束力的承诺，因此生态系统服务提供者不确定其为向用户转移服务将获得多少补偿。鉴于实证研究制度的其他方法存在局限，以及对信任下行为进行理论预测的局限，我们采用了决策实验。在我们将公平与效率解耦的讨价还价博弈中，我们发现，强制执行的合同提高了效率，也提高了所有公平性指标。这为设计管理生态系统服务转移的制度提供了依据，因为剩余分配的公平本身就很重要，同时也使有效配置成为可能。

title: Impacts of Certification, Uncertified Concessions, Hunting Zones and Protected Areas on Forest Loss in Cameroon, 2000 to 2013
abstract: Deforestation and forest fragmentation are leading drivers of biodiversity loss. Protected areas have been the leading conservation policy response, yet their scale and scope remain inadequate to meet biodiversity conservation targets. Managed forest concessions increasingly have been recognized as a complement to protected areas in meeting conservation targets. Similarly, programs for voluntary third-party certification of concession management aim to create incentives for logging companies to manage forests more sustainably. Rigorous evidence on the impacts from large-scale certification programs is thereby critical, yet detailed field observations are limited, temporally and spatially. Remotely-sensed data, in contrast, can provide repeated observations over time and at a fine spatial scale, albeit with less detail. Using the Global Forest Change dataset, we examine annual forest loss in Cameroon during 2000–2013 to assess the impact of Forest Stewardship Council certification, as well as uncertified logging concessions and national parks. We use panel regressions that control for the effects of unobserved factors that vary across space or time. We find low forest loss inside the boundaries of each management intervention, with < 1% lost over the study period. Yet those low levels of loss appear to be influenced more by a site’s proximity to drivers of deforestation, such as distances to population centers or roads, than by national parks, uncertified concessions, or certification. The exception is that if a site faces high deforestation pressure, uncertified logging concessions appear to reduce forest loss. This may reflect private companies’ incentives to protect rights to forest use. Such an influence of private logging companies could provide a foundation for future impacts from certification upon rates of forest loss, at least within areas that are facing elevated deforestation pressures.
abstract_zh: 森林砍伐与森林破碎化是生物多样性丧失的主要驱动因素。保护区一直是主要的保护政策应对，但其规模与范围仍不足以实现生物多样性保护目标。越来越多的人认识到，有管理的森林特许经营是保护区的补充，有助于实现保护目标。同样，旨在激励伐木公司更可持续地管理森林的特许经营管理自愿第三方认证项目也应运而生。因此，大规模认证项目影响的严格证据至关重要，然而详细的实地观测在时间和空间上都很有限。相比之下，遥感数据可以以精细的空间尺度提供重复观测，尽管细节较少。我们利用全球森林变化数据集，考察了2000–2013年喀麦隆的年度森林损失，以评估森林管理委员会（FSC）认证的影响，以及未认证的伐木特许经营和国家公园的影响。我们使用面板回归，控制了随空间或时间变化的不可观测因素的影响。我们发现，在每个管理干预的边界内森林损失都很低，研究期间损失不到1%。然而，这些低损失水平似乎更多地受到某地点与毁林驱动因素（如到人口中心或道路的距离）的接近程度影响，而非受国家公园、未认证特许经营或认证的影响。例外情况是，如果某地点面临较高的毁林压力，未认证的伐木特许经营似乎会减少森林损失。这可能反映了私营伐木公司保护森林使用权的激励。私营伐木公司的这种影响，可能为认证在至少面临较高毁林压力的地区对森林损失率产生未来影响奠定基础。

title: Land-use and land-cover change shape the sustainability and impacts of protected areas
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences 115(9):2084-2089
abstract: Emerging evidence shows that the boundaries of protected areas (PAs) and their level of protection regularly change, yet little is known regarding the underlying causes of these legal changes and their impacts on ecosystems. For PA degazettements (i.e., protection removals) in the state of Rondônia in the Brazilian Amazon we show that the PAs less effective in stemming deforestation are more likely to be degazetted. For those already deforested PAs degazettement had limited, if any, additional impact on deforestation. Consistent with the scientific literature recognizing that governance shapes conservation outcomes, governance that improves PA outcomes also improves their legal durability. Our evidence on such relationships suggests directions for research and the need for policymakers to reexamine conventional wisdom regarding PAs.
abstract_zh: 新的证据表明，保护区（PAs）的边界及其保护水平经常发生变化，但对于这些法律变化的根本原因及其对生态系统的影响，我们知之甚少。针对巴西亚马逊地区罗朗多尼亚州保护区的撤销保护（即取消保护地位）情况，我们发现，遏制毁林效果较差的保护区更有可能被撤销保护。对于那些已经发生毁林的保护区，撤销保护对毁林的额外影响即使有，也非常有限。与认识到治理影响保护成效的科学文献一致，能够改善保护区成效的治理，也提高了其法律上的持久性。我们关于这些关系的证据指明了研究方向，也表明政策制定者需要重新审视关于保护区的传统观念。

title: Nature can deliver on the SDGs
abstract: The increasing availability of data and improved analytic techniques now enable us to better understand when and where investing in nature can deliver net benefits for people − especially with respect to the most vulnerable populations in developing countries. These advances open the door for efficient interventions that can advance multiple SDGs at once. Recently, we harmonized a suite of global datasets to explore the critical nexus of forests, poverty and human health – an overlap of SDGs 1, 2, 3, 6 and 15. Our approach combined demographic and health surveys for 297,112 children in 35 developing countries with data describing the local environmental conditions for each child4 (Fig. 1a; see online materials for details). This allowed us to estimate the effect forests may play in supporting human health, while controlling for the influence of important socio-economic differences. We extended this work to look at how forests affect three childhood health concerns of global significance – stunting, anemia, and diarrheal disease.
abstract_zh: 数据可得性的提高与分析技术的进步，使我们能够更好地理解在何时何地投资自然能为人类带来净收益，尤其是对发展中国家最脆弱的人群。这些进展为能够同时推进多个可持续发展目标（SDGs）的高效干预打开了大门。近期，我们协调了一组全球数据集，以探讨森林、贫困与人类健康这一关键关联，即可持续发展目标1、2、3、6和15的交叉领域。我们的方法将35个发展中国家297,112名儿童的人口与健康调查数据，与描述每名儿童所在地环境条件的数据相结合（图1a；详见在线材料）。这使我们能够估计森林在支持人类健康方面可能发挥的作用，同时控制重要社会经济差异的影响。我们将这项工作延伸至森林如何影响三种具有全球重要性的儿童健康问题：发育迟缓、贫血和腹泻病。

title: Roads & SDGs, Tradeoffs and Synergies: learning from Brazil’s Amazon in distinguishing frontiers
abstract: To reduce SDG tradeoffs in infrastructure provision, and to inform searches for SDG synergies, the authors show that roads’ impacts on Brazilian Amazon forests varied significantly across frontiers. Impacts varied predictably with prior development – prior roads and prior deforestation – and, further, in a pattern that suggests a potential synergy for roads between forests and urban growth. For multiple periods of roads investments, the authors estimate forest impacts for high, medium and low prior roads and deforestation. For each setting, census-tract observations are numerous. Results confirm predictions for this kind of frontier of a pattern not consistent with endogeneity, i.e., short-run forest impacts of new roads are: small for relatively high prior development; larger for medium prior development; and small for low prior development (for the latter setting, impacts in such isolated areas could rise over time, depending on interactions with conservation policies). These Amazonian results suggest ‘SDG strategic’ locations for infrastructure, an idea the authors note for other frontiers while highlighting major differences across frontiers and their SDG opportunities.
abstract_zh: 为减少基础设施供给中的可持续发展目标（SDG）权衡，并为寻找SDG协同效应提供依据，作者发现，道路对巴西亚马逊森林的影响在不同开发前沿之间存在显著差异。这些影响可以根据先前的开发状况（既有道路和既有森林砍伐）进行预测变化，而且其模式表明，道路在森林与城市增长之间可能存在协同效应。针对多个时期的道路投资，作者分别估计了既有道路和既有森林砍伐处于高、中、低水平时的森林影响。在每种情形下，普查区观测值都很多。结果证实了这类前沿地区的预测，且该模式与内生性不一致：新建道路的短期森林影响在既有开发水平较高时较小，在既有开发水平中等时较大，在既有开发水平较低时又较小（对于后一种情形，这些孤立地区的影响可能随时间推移而增加，具体取决于其与保护政策的相互作用）。这些亚马逊地区的结果提示了基础设施的“SDG战略性”选址，作者也指出这一思路同样适用于其他前沿地区，同时强调了不同前沿地区之间的重大差异及其SDG机遇。

title: Heterogeneous Local Spillovers from Protected Areas in Costa Rica
abstract: Spillovers can significantly reduce or enhance the net effects of land-use policies, yet there exists little rigorous evidence concerning their magnitudes. We examine how Costa Rica’s national parks affect deforestation in nearby areas. We find that average deforestation spillovers are not significant in 0–5 km and 5–10 km rings around the parks. However, this average blends multiple effects that are significant and that vary in magnitude across the landscape, yielding varied net impacts. We distinguish the locations with different net spillovers by their distances to roads and park entrances—both of which are of economic importance, given critical local roles for transport costs and tourism. We find large and statistically significant leakage close to roads but far from park entrances, which are areas with high agricultural returns and less influenced by tourism. We do not find leakage far from roads (lower agriculture returns) or close to park entrances (higher tourism returns). Finally, parks facing greater threats of deforestation show greater leakage.
abstract_zh: 溢出效应可以显著减弱或增强土地利用政策的净效应，但关于其大小的严格证据却很少。我们考察了哥斯达黎加国家公园如何影响其附近地区的森林砍伐。我们发现，在公园周围0–5公里和5–10公里的环带内，平均森林砍伐溢出效应并不显著。然而，这一平均值混合了多种显著且在景观中大小各异的效应，从而产生了不同的净影响。我们依据各地与道路及公园入口的距离来区分不同净溢出效应的地点，而道路和公园入口都具有重要的经济意义，因为它们分别对运输成本和旅游业具有关键的地方性作用。我们发现，在靠近道路但远离公园入口的地区存在较大且统计上显著的泄漏（leakage），这些地区的农业收益较高，且受旅游业的影响较小。在远离道路（农业收益较低）或靠近公园入口（旅游收益较高）的地区，我们未发现泄漏。最后，面临更大森林砍伐威胁的公园表现出更大的泄漏。
