title: Reduction in exposure to arsenic from drinking well-water in Bangladesh limited by insufficient testing and awareness
venue: Journal of Water, Sanitation and Hygiene for Development 07.2
abstract: This study considers potential policy responses to the still very high levels of exposure to arsenic (As) caused by drinking water from shallow tubewells in rural Bangladesh. It examines a survey of 4,109 households in 76 villages of Araihazar upazila conducted two years after a national testing campaign swept through the area. The area is adjacent to the region where a long-term study was initiated in 2000 and where households are periodically reminded of health risks associated with well-water elevated in As. Results confirm that testing spurs switching away from unsafe wells, although the 27% fraction who switched was only about half of that in the long-term study area. By village, the fraction of households that switched varied with the availability of safe wells and the distance from the long-term study area. Lacking follow-up testing, two years only after the campaign 21% of households did not know the status of their well and 21% of households with an unsafe well that switched did so to an untested well. Well testing is again urgently needed in Bangladesh and should be paired with better ways to raise awareness and the installation of additional deep community wells.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了针对孟加拉国农村地区浅层管井饮用水中砷（As）暴露水平仍然很高这一问题可能采取的政策应对措施。研究使用了在全国性水质检测运动席卷该地区两年后，在Araihazar乡（upazila）76个村庄中进行的4,109户家庭调查。该地区与一项长期研究的区域相邻，该长期研究始于2000年，研究对象的家庭会定期被提醒井水砷含量升高所带来的健康风险。结果证实，检测会促使家庭改用不安全的水井，但改用水井的家庭比例（27%）仅约为长期研究区域的一半。在村庄层面，改用水井的家庭比例随安全水井的可获得性以及与长期研究区域的距离而变化。在缺乏后续检测的情况下，运动结束仅两年后，21%的家庭不知道自家水井的状况，而在使用不安全水井并改用其他水井的家庭中，有21%改用了未经检测的水井。孟加拉国亟需再次开展水井检测，并应与提高公众认知的更好方式以及增设深层社区水井相结合。

title: Spillovers from Conservation Programs
abstract: Conservation programs have increased significantly, as has the evaluation of their impacts. However, the evaluation of their potential impacts beyond program borders has been scarce. Such spillovers can significantly reduce or increase net impacts. In this review, we discuss how conservation programs might affect outcomes beyond their borders and present some evidence of when they have or have not. We focus on five major channels by which spillovers can arise: (1) input reallocation; (2) market prices; (3) learning; (4) nonpecuniary motivations; and (5) ecological-physical links. We highlight evidence for each channel and emphasize that estimates often may reflect multiple channels. Future research could test for spillovers within different contexts and could separate the effects of different channels.
abstract_zh: 保护项目的规模显著扩大，对其影响的评估也随之增多。然而，对其在项目边界之外的潜在影响的评估却十分稀少。此类溢出效应可能显著降低或提高项目的净影响。在本综述中，我们讨论了保护项目可能如何影响其边界之外的结果，并列举了溢出效应在何时出现或未出现的部分证据。我们重点关注溢出效应产生的五个主要渠道：（1）投入要素的再配置；（2）市场价格；（3）学习；（4）非金钱动机；以及（5）生态—物理联系。我们重点列出了每个渠道的相关证据，并强调估计结果往往可能反映了多种渠道的共同作用。未来的研究可以在不同情境下检验溢出效应，并区分不同渠道的效应。

title: Spillovers from Targeting of Incentives: exploring responses to being excluded
abstract: A growing set of policies involve transfers conditioned upon socially desired actions, such as attending school or conserving forest. However, given a desire to maximize the impact of limited funds by avoiding transfers that do not change behavior, typically some potential recipients are excluded on the basis of their characteristics, their actions or at random. This paper uses a laboratory experiment to study the behavior of individuals excluded on different bases from a new incentive that encourages real monetary donations to a public environmental conservation program. We show that the donations from the individuals who were excluded based on prior high contributions fell significantly. Yet the rationale used for exclusion mattered, in that none of the other selection criteria used as the basis for exclusion resulted in negative effects on contributions.
abstract_zh: 越来越多的政策涉及以社会期望的行为为条件的转移支付，例如上学或保护森林。然而，出于使有限资金的影响最大化、避免向不会改变行为的对象支付的考虑，通常会根据潜在受助者的特征、行为或随机方式将部分人排除在外。本文通过一项实验室实验，研究了在一项新激励机制中被以不同方式排除在外的个体的行为，该激励机制旨在鼓励对公共环境保护项目进行真实的货币捐赠。我们发现，因既往高额捐赠而被排除在外的个体，其捐赠额显著下降。然而，排除的理由很重要：作为排除依据的其他筛选标准均未对捐赠产生负面影响。

title: Upstream watershed condition predicts rural children’s health across 35 developing countries
abstract: Diarrheal disease (DD) due to contaminated water is a major cause of child mortality globally. Forests and wetlands can provide ecosystem services that help maintain water quality. To understand the connections between land cover and childhood DD, we compiled a database of 293,362 children in 35 countries with information on health, socioeconomic factors, climate, and watershed condition. Using hierarchical models, here we find that higher upstream tree cover is associated with lower probability of DD downstream. This effect is significant for rural households but not for urban households, suggesting differing dependence on watershed conditions. In rural areas, the effect of a 30% increase in upstream tree cover is similar to the effect of improved sanitation, but smaller than the effect of improved water source, wealth or education. We conclude that maintaining natural capital within watersheds can be an important public health investment, especially for populations with low levels of built capital.
abstract_zh: 因水源受污染而引发的腹泻病（DD）是全球儿童死亡的主要原因之一。森林和湿地能够提供有助于维持水质的生态系统服务。为了解土地覆盖与儿童腹泻病之间的关系，我们汇编了35个国家293,362名儿童的数据库，其中包含健康、社会经济因素、气候和流域状况等信息。利用分层模型，我们发现上游树木覆盖率越高，下游发生腹泻病的概率越低。该效应在农村家庭中显著，而在城市家庭中不显著，这表明两者对流域状况的依赖程度不同。在农村地区，上游树木覆盖率提高30%的效应，与改善卫生设施的效应相近，但小于改善水源、提高财富或教育水平的效应。我们的结论是，维护流域内的自然资本可以成为一项重要的公共卫生投资，对于人力资本积累水平较低（即人造资本不足）的人群尤为如此。

title: Evolving Protected-Area Impacts in Mexico: Political Shifts as Suggested by Impact Evaluations
abstract: For protected areas (PAs), variation in forest impacts over space—including types of PA—are increasingly well documented, while shifts in impacts over time receive less attention. For Mexico, in the 1990s, PAs effectively were ‘paper parks’. Thus, achieving impacts on the forest would require shifts over time in the politics of PA siting and PA implementation. We rigorously analyze the impacts of Mexican PAs on 2000–2005 loss of natural land cover, using matching to reduce location bias caused by typical land-use economics and politics. We find a 3.2% lower loss, on average, due to PAs. Since politics often vary by type of PA, we also show that in Mexico stricter PAs are closer to cities and have greater impact than mixed-use PAs. These shifts in impacts suggest some potential for PAs to conserve forests.
abstract_zh: 对于保护区（PA）而言，其森林影响在空间上的差异（包括保护区类型的差异）已有越来越充分的记录，而其影响随时间的变化则较少受到关注。以墨西哥为例，在20世纪90年代，保护区实际上只是“纸面公园”。因此，要想对森林产生实际影响，就需要保护区选址和实施的政治环境随时间发生转变。我们运用匹配方法，严格分析了墨西哥保护区对2000–2005年自然土地覆盖损失的影响，以减少典型土地利用经济学和政治因素所导致的选址偏差。我们发现，由于设立保护区，损失平均降低了3.2%。由于政治环境往往因保护区类型而异，我们还表明，在墨西哥，较严格的保护区距离城市更近，且其影响大于混合用途保护区。这些影响的转变表明，保护区具有一定的森林保护潜力。

title: Deforestation dynamics in response to the evolution of the Western Amazonian Inter-Oceanic Highway
abstract: Over the last three decades, the first continuous road has been paved to connect northern South America’s Atlantic and Pacific coasts. The final sections of this Inter-Oceanic Highway are now being completed through the western Amazon Basin, a global biodiversity hotspot, at the triple-border of Brazil, Bolivia and Peru. Satellite images from 1989, 2000, and 2007 reveal accelerating clearing across the region, but the countries’ prior infrastructures governed their individual responses to the road. Brazilian deforestation slowed as the frontier expanded away from the highway with a network of capillary roads, but Bolivian clearing accelerated as its urban centers sprawled toward the road. Peru’s forests remain relatively intact, but similar trends isolated from Brazil suggest imminent acceleration as Peruvian infrastructural capacity increases.
abstract_zh: 过去三十年间，连接南美洲北部大西洋与太平洋沿岸的第一条连续公路已经建成。这条洲际公路的最后路段目前正在西部亚马逊盆地（全球生物多样性热点地区）建设中，该地区位于巴西、玻利维亚和秘鲁三国交界处。1989年、2000年和2007年的卫星影像显示，该地区的砍伐正在加速，但各国既有的基础设施决定了其对这条公路的不同反应。随着开发前沿借助毛细道路网络向公路以外扩展，巴西的森林砍伐有所放缓；而玻利维亚的城市中心向公路蔓延，导致其砍伐加速。秘鲁的森林仍然相对完好，但与巴西隔离的类似趋势表明，随着秘鲁基础设施能力的提升，其森林砍伐可能即将加速。

title: Scaling up conservation impact in Madagascar
abstract: Ten years ago, Madagascar’s government committed to drastically scale up the nation’s protected-area coverage from ~3% to 10% of its area. We ask how successful this PA expansion is likely to be in terms of reducing deforestation (and, thereby, increasing the conservation of biodiversity). We statistically evaluate the impact of the prior generations of Malagasy PAs and use those results to anticipate the conservation impacts of Madagascar’s newest PAs. We find that deforestation was reduced by the prior PAs, although by less than suggested in simpler comparisons that lack explicit controls for land characteristics. Further, impacts are higher where deforestation pressure is higher, which often is closer to roads and cities (and which also may imply higher costs). We find Madagascar’s newest PAs are sited where, if managed correctly, they can achieve impacts at least as high as prior conservation.
abstract_zh: 十年前，马达加斯加政府承诺大幅扩大国家保护区覆盖面，从其国土面积的约3%提高到10%。我们探讨了这一保护区扩张在减少森林砍伐（从而增进生物多样性保护）方面可能取得的成效。我们对马达加斯加以往各代保护区的影响进行了统计评估，并利用这些结果预测了该国最新保护区的保护效果。我们发现，既有保护区确实减少了森林砍伐，但减少幅度低于那些未明确控制土地特征的简单比较所显示的幅度。此外，在森林砍伐压力较大的地区，保护区的影响更大，而这些地区往往更靠近道路和城市（这也可能意味着更高的成本）。我们发现，马达加斯加最新的保护区选址于这样一些地方：如果管理得当，其影响至少能达到以往保护措施的水平。

title: Sequenced Road Investments & Clearing Of The Mayan Forest
abstract: The Selva Maya is an important tropical forest, the second biggest in the Americas after the Amazon and the largest continuous forest patch of the ‘Mesoamerican hotspot’ which contains around 7% of the world species . Located across Mexico, Belize and Guatemala, Selva Maya is subject to different policy, cultural and historical influences and to a grand road expansion program that will intersect its core . Given its biological importance and the environmental services it provides at a local and global scale, this region is a good case to consider road impacts. We focus on four questions: 1) what are the short and medium term effects of paved and unpaved roads investments on deforestation?; 2) do these impacts differ when roads are placed in areas with existing pressure vs. in less developed locations?; 3) do the effect of non-road drivers also vary with development contexts? We might expect that roads in previously pristine areas a new road will be the dominant predictor; and 4) using a different measure of context, do road impacts vary across the countries?
abstract_zh: 玛雅森林（Selva Maya）是一片重要的热带森林，是美洲仅次于亚马逊的第二大热带森林，也是“中美洲热点地区”内最大的连续林地，该地区蕴藏着全球约7%的物种。玛雅森林横跨墨西哥、伯利兹和危地马拉，受到不同政策、文化和历史因素的影响，并且面临一项大规模的道路扩建计划，该计划将穿越其核心区域。鉴于该地区的生物学重要性以及其在地方和全球尺度上提供的环境服务，该地区是考察道路影响的理想案例。我们聚焦于四个问题：1）铺装和未铺装道路投资在短期和中期对森林砍伐有何影响？2）当道路修建在已有开发压力的地区，与修建在开发程度较低的地区时，这些影响是否存在差异？3）非道路驱动因素的影响是否也随开发背景而变化？我们可能预期，在此前未受干扰的原始地区，新建道路将成为主导性的预测因素；4）使用另一种衡量背景的指标，道路影响在各国之间是否存在差异？

title: Entry Points for Considering Ecosystem Services within Infrastructure Planning: how to integrate conservation with development in order to aid them both
abstract: New infrastructure is needed globally to support economic development and improve human well‐being. Investments that do not consider ecosystem services (ES) can eliminate these important societal benefits from nature, undermining the development benefits infrastructure is intended to provide. Such tradeoffs are acknowledged conceptually but in practice have rarely been considered in infrastructure planning. Taking road investments as one important case, here we examine where and what forms of ES information have the potential to meaningfully influence decisions by multilateral development banks (MDBs). Across the stages of a typical road development process, we identify where and how ES information could be integrated, likely barriers to the use of available ES information, and key opportunities to shift incentives and thereby practice. We believe inclusion of ES information is likely to provide the greatest development benefit in early stages of infrastructure decisions. Those strategic planning stages are typically guided by in‐country processes, with MDBs playing a supporting role, making it critical to express the ES consequences of infrastructure development using metrics relevant to government decision makers. This approach requires additional evidence of the in‐country benefits of cross‐sector strategic planning and more tools to lower barriers to quantifying these benefits and facilitating ES inclusion.
abstract_zh: 全球范围内都需要新的基础设施，以支持经济发展并改善人类福祉。如果投资不考虑生态系统服务（ES），就可能使自然界为社会带来的这些重要益处消失，从而削弱基础设施原本应当带来的发展效益。这类权衡取舍在概念上已得到承认，但在实践中很少被纳入基础设施规划。以道路投资为典型案例，我们考察了在哪些环节以及以何种形式纳入生态系统服务信息，才有可能对多边开发银行（MDB）的决策产生实质性影响。通过梳理典型道路开发流程的各个阶段，我们确定了生态系统服务信息可以在何处、以何种方式被整合，识别了使用现有生态系统服务信息可能面临的主要障碍，并指出了改变激励机制从而改变实践的关键机遇。我们认为，在基础设施决策的早期阶段纳入生态系统服务信息，可能带来最大的发展效益。这些战略规划阶段通常由国内进程主导，多边开发银行仅发挥辅助作用，因此，必须采用与政府决策者相关的指标来表述基础设施开发的生态系统服务后果。这一方法需要更多证据来证明跨部门战略规划在国内层面的收益，并需要更多工具来降低量化这些收益的门槛，从而促进生态系统服务被纳入决策。

title: Estimating the Impacts of Local Policy Innovation: the synthetic control method applied to tropical deforestation
abstract: Quasi-experimental methods increasingly are used to evaluate the impacts of conservation interventions by generating credible estimates of counterfactual baselines. These methods generally require large samples for statistical comparisons, presenting a challenge for evaluating innovative policies implemented within a few pioneering jurisdictions. Single jurisdictions often are studied using comparative methods, which rely on analysts' selection of best case comparisons. The synthetic control method (SCM) offers one systematic and transparent way to select cases for comparison, from a sizeable pool, by focusing upon similarity in outcomes before the intervention. We explain SCM, then apply it to one local initiative to limit deforestation in the Brazilian Amazon. The municipality of Paragominas launched a multi-pronged local initiative in 2008 to maintain low deforestation while restoring economic production. This was a response to having been placed, due to high deforestation, on a federal "blacklist" that increased enforcement of forest regulations and restricted access to credit and output markets. The local initiative included mapping and monitoring of rural land plus promotion of economic alternatives compatible with low deforestation. The key motivation for the program may have been to reduce the costs of blacklisting. However its stated purpose was to limit deforestation, and thus we apply SCM to estimate what deforestation would have been in a (counterfactual) scenario of no local initiative. We obtain a plausible estimate, in that deforestation patterns before the intervention were similar in Paragominas and the synthetic control, which suggests that after several years, the initiative did lower deforestation (significantly below the synthetic control in 2012). This demonstrates that SCM can yield helpful land-use counterfactuals for single units, with opportunities to integrate local and expert knowledge and to test innovations and permutations on policies that are implemented in just a few locations.
abstract_zh: 准实验方法越来越多地被用于评估保护干预措施的影响，其途径是生成可信的反事实基准。这些方法通常需要较大的样本以进行统计比较，这给评估仅在少数先行地区实施的创新政策带来了挑战。对于单一地区，通常采用比较方法进行研究，但这依赖于分析者对最佳比较案例的选择。合成控制法（SCM）提供了一种系统且透明的方法，可以从庞大的备选池中，依据干预前结果的相似性来选择比较案例。我们阐述了SCM，并将其应用于巴西亚马逊地区一项限制森林砍伐的地方性倡议。帕拉戈米纳斯（Paragominas）市于2008年发起了一项多管齐下的地方性倡议，旨在维持较低的森林砍伐水平，同时恢复经济生产。这一倡议是对该市因高森林砍伐率而被列入联邦“黑名单”的回应，该名单加强了对森林法规的执法，并限制了其获得信贷和进入产品市场的机会。该地方倡议包括对农村土地进行测绘和监测，并推广与低森林砍伐相容的经济替代方案。该项目的主要动机可能是降低被列入黑名单的成本。然而，其既定目标是限制森林砍伐，因此我们运用SCM估计，在没有该地方倡议的（反事实）情景下，森林砍伐将会是什么水平。我们得到了一个合理的估计：干预前帕拉戈米纳斯与合成控制地区的森林砍伐格局相似，这表明经过数年，该倡议确实降低了森林砍伐（在2012年显著低于合成控制地区）。这说明，SCM能够为单一单元提供有益的土地利用反事实，并且有机会整合地方和专家知识，检验仅在少数地点实施的政策的创新与变体。

title: Evaluating Interactions of Forest Conservation Policies on Avoided Deforestation
abstract: We estimate the effects on deforestation that have resulted from policy interactions between parks and payments and between park buffers and payments in Costa Rica between 2000 and 2005. We show that the characteristics of the areas where protected and unprotected lands are located differ significantly. Additionally, we find that land characteristics of each of the policies and of the places where they interact also differ significantly. To adequately estimate the effects of the policies and their interactions, we use matching methods. Matching is implemented not only to define adequate control groups, as in previous research, but also to define those groups of locations under the influence of policies that are comparable to each other. We find that it is more effective to locate parks and payments away from each other, rather than in the same location or near each other. The high levels of enforcement inside both parks and lands with payments, and the presence of conservation spillovers that reduce deforestation near parks, significantly reduce the potential impact of combining these two policies.
abstract_zh: 我们估计了2000至2005年间哥斯达黎加在公园与补偿支付之间、以及公园缓冲区与补偿支付之间的政策互动所产生的森林砍伐效应。我们发现，受保护土地与未受保护土地所在区域的特征存在显著差异。此外，我们还发现，各项政策以及它们相互作用所在地点的土地特征也存在显著差异。为了充分估计各项政策及其相互作用的效应，我们采用了匹配方法。与以往研究一样，我们使用匹配不仅是为了界定适当的对照组，还是为了界定那些受政策影响且彼此之间可比的地点组。我们发现，将公园和补偿支付设置在彼此远离的位置，比将其设在同一地点或彼此相邻更为有效。公园内部和获得补偿支付的土地上执法力度都很大，同时公园附近存在可以减少森林砍伐的保护溢出效应，这些因素都显著降低了将两项政策结合使用的潜在影响。

title: Framed field experiment on resource scarcity & extraction: path-dependent generosity within sequential water appropriation
abstract: How one treats others is important within collective action. We ask if resource scarcity in the past, due to its effects upon past behaviors, influences current other-regarding behaviors. Contrasting theories and empirical findings on scarcity motivate our framed field experiment. Participants are rural Colombian farmers who have experienced scarcity of water within irrigation. We randomly assign participants to groups and places on group canals. Places order extraction decisions. Our treatments are sequences of scarcities: ‘from lower to higher resources’ involves four rounds each of 20, 60, then 100 units of water; ‘from higher to lower resources’ reverses the ordering. We find that upstream farmers extract more, but a lower share, when facing higher resources. Further they take a larger share of higher resources when they faced lower resources in earlier rounds (relative to when facing higher resources initially). That is inconsistent with leading models of responses to scarcity which focus upon one’s own gain. It is consistent with lowering one’s weight on others to, for instance, rationalize having left them little. Our results suggest that facing higher scarcity can erode the bases for collective actions. For establishing new institutions, timing relative to scarcity could affect the probability of success.
abstract_zh: 人们如何对待他人对集体行动而言至关重要。我们探讨过去的资源稀缺是否会因其对过去行为的影响，进而左右当前的利他行为。关于稀缺性的相互对立的理论和实证发现促使我们开展了这项框架化的田野实验。受试者为经历过灌溉用水短缺的哥伦比亚农村农民。我们将受试者随机分组，并安排在各组的渠道位置上。位置决定了取水决策的先后顺序。我们的处理条件是一系列稀缺序列：“从低资源到高资源”包括四轮，每轮分别为20、60、然后100单位的水；“从高资源到低资源”则反转了这一顺序。我们发现，上游农民在面对较高资源时取水更多，但所占份额更低。此外，与最初面对较高资源时相比，若他们在较早的轮次中面对的是较低资源，那么在面对较高资源时会获取更大的份额。这与以自身收益为核心的主流稀缺反应模型不一致，而与降低自身对他人福利的权重相符（例如，用以为自己留下较多水量的理由来为只给他人留下很少水量辩护）。我们的结果表明，面对更高的稀缺程度可能侵蚀集体行动的基础。对于建立新的制度而言，相对于稀缺出现的时机，可能会影响其成功的概率。

title: Paper Park Performance: Mexico’s Natural Protected Areas in the 1990s
abstract: Although developing countries have established scores of new protected areas over the past three decades, they often amount to little more than ‘‘paper parks’’ that are chronically short of the financial, human, and technical resources needed for effective management. It is not clear whether and how severely under-resourced parks affect deforestation. In principle, they could either stem it by, for example, creating an expectation of future enforcement, or they could spur it by, for example, creating open access regimes. We examine the effect of Mexico’s natural protected areas (NPAs) on deforestation from 1993 to 2000, a period when forest clearing was rampant and the vast majority of protected areas had negligible resources or management. We use high-resolution satellite data to measure deforestation and (covariate and propensity score) matching to control for NPAs’ nonrandom siting and for spillovers. Our broad finding is that Mexico’s paper parks had heterogeneous effects both inside and outside their borders. More specifically, at the national-level, we cannot reject the null hypothesis that NPAs had zero average effect on clearing inside their borders, nor can we reject a similar hypothesis for spillover clearing outside their borders. However, we can detect statistically and economically significant inside- and outside-NPA effects for certain geographic regions. Moreover, these effects have different signs depending on the region. Finally, we find that NPAs with certain characteristics were more effective at stemming deforestation inside their borders, namely, those that were large, new, mixed use, and relatively well-funded. Taken together, these results suggest that paper parks have the potential to either reduce or exacerbate tropical deforestation and highlight the need for further research on the conditions that lead to each outcome.
abstract_zh: 尽管过去三十年间发展中国家设立了大量新的保护区，但这些保护区往往仅仅是“纸面公园”，长期缺乏有效管理所需的资金、人力和技术资源。目前尚不清楚资源严重不足的公园是否以及在多大程度上影响森林砍伐。原则上，它们既可能通过例如形成未来执法的预期而遏制砍伐，也可能通过例如形成开放获取的制度而助长砍伐。我们考察了1993至2000年间墨西哥自然保护区（NPA）对森林砍伐的影响，这一时期森林砍伐猖獗，而绝大多数保护区几乎没有资源或管理。我们利用高分辨率卫星数据来测量森林砍伐，并采用（协变量与倾向得分）匹配方法，以控制自然保护区选址的非随机性以及溢出效应。我们的总体发现是，墨西哥的“纸面公园”对其边界内外均产生了异质性的效应。更具体地说，在全国层面，我们无法拒绝自然保护区在其边界内对砍伐的平均效应为零的原假设，也无法拒绝其边界外溢出性砍伐的类似假设。然而，在某些地理区域，我们能够探测到在统计上和经济上均显著的保护区内外效应。而且，这些效应的符号因地区而异。最后，我们发现具有某些特征的自然保护区在遏制其边界内的森林砍伐方面更为有效，即规模较大、较新、实行混合用途且资金相对充足的保护区。综合来看，这些结果表明，纸面公园既有可能减少热带森林砍伐，也可能加剧热带森林砍伐，并凸显了进一步研究导致每种结果的条件的必要性。

title: Protected Areas’ Impacts on Brazilian Amazon Deforestation: examining conservation – development interactions to inform planning
abstract: Protected areas are the leading forest conservation policy for species and ecoservices goals and they may feature in climate policy if countries with tropical forest rely on familiar tools. For Brazil's Legal Amazon, we estimate the average impact of protection upon deforestation and show how protected areas' forest impacts vary significantly with development pressure. We use matching, i.e., comparisons that are apples-to-apples in observed land characteristics, to address the fact that protected areas (PAs) tend to be located on lands facing less pressure. Correcting for that location bias lowers our estimates of PAs' forest impacts by roughly half. Further, it reveals significant variation in PA impacts along development-related dimensions: for example, the PAs that are closer to roads and the PAs closer to cities have higher impact. Planners have multiple conservation and development goals, and are constrained by cost, yet still conservation planning should reflect what our results imply about future impacts of PAs.
abstract_zh: 保护区是针对物种和生态服务目标的主要森林保护政策，如果有森林的国家依赖熟悉的工具，它们也可能被纳入气候政策之中。针对巴西法定亚马逊地区，我们估计了保护对森林砍伐的平均影响，并展示了保护区的森林影响如何随开发压力的不同而显著变化。我们采用匹配方法，即在可观测的土地特征方面进行“同类比较”，以解决保护区（PA）往往设在面临较小压力的土地上这一事实所带来的问题。纠正这一选址偏差后，我们对保护区森林影响的估计大约降低了一半。此外，这一方法还揭示了保护区影响在与开发相关的维度上存在显著差异：例如，距离道路较近的保护区和距离城市较近的保护区具有更大的影响。规划者面临多重保护与发展目标，并且受到成本的约束，但保护规划仍应反映我们的结果对保护区未来影响的启示。

title: Protected area types, strategies and impacts in Brazil’s Amazon: public PA strategies do not yield a consistent ranking of PA types by impact
abstract: The leading policy to conserve forest is protected areas (PAs). Yet, PAs are not a single tool: land users and uses vary by PA type; and public PA strategies vary in the extent of each type and in the determinants of impact for each type, i.e. siting and internal deforestation. Further, across regions and time, strategies respond to pressures (deforestation and political). We estimate deforestation impacts of PA types for a critical frontier, the Brazilian Amazon. We separate regions and time periods that differ in their deforestation and political pressures and document considerable variation in PA strategies across regions, time periods and types. The siting of PAs varies across regions. For example, all else being equal, PAs in the arc of deforestation are relatively far from non-forest, while in other states they are relatively near. Internal deforestation varies across time periods, e.g. it is more similar across the PA types for PAs after 2000. By contrast, after 2000, PA extent is less similar across PA types with little non-indigenous area created inside the arc. PA strategies generate a range of impacts for PA types—always far higher within the arc—but not a consistent ranking of PA types by impact.
abstract_zh: 保护森林的首要政策工具是保护区（PAs）。然而，保护区并非单一工具：土地使用者及其用途因保护区类型而异；公共保护区战略在各类型保护区的规模以及各类型影响的决定因素（即选址和内部森林砍伐）上也存在差异。此外，在不同地区和不同时期，各项战略会对压力（森林砍伐压力与政治压力）作出回应。我们针对一个关键的边疆地区——巴西亚马逊——估计了各类保护区的森林砍伐影响。我们区分了森林砍伐压力和政治压力各不相同的地区与时期，并记录了各地区、各时期及各类型保护区之间战略的显著差异。保护区的选址在不同地区存在差异。例如，在其他条件相同的情况下，位于“森林砍伐弧”内的保护区距离非森林地带相对较远，而在其他州则相对较近。内部森林砍伐在不同时期有所差异，例如，2000年以后，各保护区类型之间的内部森林砍伐情况更为相似。相比之下，2000年以后，各保护区类型的规模差异更大，在“弧”内新设的非原住民保护区面积很少。保护区战略对各类型保护区产生了一系列影响——“弧”内的影响始终远高于其他地区——但各类型保护区按影响大小的排序并不一致。

title: Unintended Effects of Targeting an Environmental Rebate
Evolving Protected-Areas Impacts in Panama: impact shifts show that plans require anticipation
abstract: Protected areas (PAs) are the leading forest conservation policy, so accurate evaluation of future PA impact is critical in conservation planning. Yet by necessity impact evaluations use past data. Here we argue that forward-looking plans should blend such evaluations with anticipation of shifts in threats. Applying improved methods to evaluate past impact, we provide rigorous support for that conceptual approach by showing that PAs' impacts on deforestation shifted with land use. We study the Republic of Panama, where species-dense tropical forest faces real pressure. Facing variation in deforestation pressure, the PAs' impacts varied across space and time . Thus, if shifts in pressure levels and patterns could be anticipated, that could raise impact.
abstract_zh: 保护区（PA）是主要的森林保护政策，因此，准确评估保护区未来的影响对保护规划至关重要。然而，影响评估必然依赖过去的数据。在此，我们认为，面向未来的规划应当将这类评估与对威胁变化的预判结合起来。通过运用改进的方法评估保护区过去的影响，我们表明保护区对森林砍伐的影响随土地利用而变化，从而为这一概念性方法提供了严谨的支持。我们以巴拿马共和国为研究对象，该国物种密集的热带森林正面临实际的压力。面对森林砍伐压力的变化，保护区的影响在空间和时间上均有所不同。因此，如果能够预判压力水平和格局的变化，就可能提高保护区的影响。

title: Deforestation and Forest Degradation: Concerns, Causes, Policies and Their Impacts
venue: Encyclopedia of Energy, Natural Resource, and Environmental Economics, (2013), vol. 2, pp. 144-149

title: Ecopayments and Deforestation in Costa Rica: a nationwide analysis of PSA’s initial years
abstract: We offer a nationwide analysis of the initial years of Costa Rica’s PSA program, which pioneered environmental-services payments and inspired similar initiatives. Our estimates of this program’s impact on deforestation, between 1997 and 2000, range from zero to one-fifth of 1% per year (i.e., deforestation is avoided on, at most, 2 out of every 1,000 enrolled hectares). The main explanation for such a low impact is an already low national deforestation rate. We also consider the effect of enrollment. Predicted deforestation on enrolled versus nonenrolled hectares, and matching analyses suggest an enrollment bias toward lower clearing threat. Enrolling land facing higher threat could raise payments’ impact on deforestation. (JEL Q24, Q28)
abstract_zh: 我们对哥斯达黎加PSA计划（即生态服务付费计划）的最初几年进行了全国性分析。该计划开创了环境服务付费的先例，并启发了类似的倡议。我们估计，该计划在1997至2000年间对森林砍伐的影响在每年零至五分之一个百分点之间（即每1,000公顷参与计划的土地中，至多有2公顷的森林砍伐被避免）。造成影响如此之低的主要原因是全国森林砍伐率本身已经很低。我们还考察了参与情况的影响。参与计划的土地与未参与计划的土地的预测森林砍伐情况以及匹配分析均表明，参与存在偏向砍伐威胁较低土地的倾向。将付费用于面临较高威胁的土地，可能提高付费对森林砍伐的影响。（JEL Q24, Q28）

title: Evolution of households' responses to the groundwater arsenic crisis in Bangladesh: information on environmental health risks can have increasing behavioral impact over time
abstract: A national campaign of well testing through 2003 enabled households in rural Bangladesh to switch, at least for drinking water, from high-arsenic wells to neighboring lower arsenic wells. We study the well-switching dynamics over time by re-interviewing, in 2008, a randomly selected subset of households in the Araihazar region who had been interviewed in 2005. Contrary to concerns that the impact of arsenic information on switching behavior would erode over time, we find that not only was 2003–2005 switching highly persistent but also new switching by 2008 doubled the share of households at unsafe wells who had switched. The passage of time also had a cost: 22 per cent of households did not recall test results by 2008. The loss of arsenic knowledge led to staying at unsafe wells and switching from safe wells. Our results support ongoing well testing for arsenic to reinforce this beneficial information.
abstract_zh: 2003年前的全国性水井检测运动使孟加拉国农村家庭能够至少在饮用水方面，从高砷水井转而使用邻近的低砷水井。我们通过在2008年对2005年曾接受访问的Araihazar地区一个随机抽取的家庭子样本进行重访，研究了井水转换行为随时间的动态变化。与人们担心砷信息对转换行为的影响会随时间消退的观点相反，我们发现，2003至2005年间的水井转换不仅高度持续，而且到2008年，新的转换行为使仍在使用不安全水井的家庭中已转换水井的比例翻了一番。时间的推移也带来了代价：到2008年，22%的家庭已不记得检测结果。砷知识的流失导致家庭继续使用不安全水井，并从安全水井转向不安全水井。我们的结果支持持续开展砷水井检测，以强化这一有益信息。

title: Governance, Location and Avoided Deforestation from Protected Areas: greater restrictions can have lower impact, due to differences in location
abstract: For Acre, in the Brazilian Amazon, we find that protection types with differences in governance, including different constraints on local economic development, also differ in their locations. Taking this into account, we estimate the deforestation impacts of these protection types that feature different levels of restrictions. To avoid bias, we compare these protected locations with unprotected locations that are similar in their characteristics relevant for deforestation. We find that sustainable use protection, whose governance permits some local deforestation, is found on sites with high clearing threat. That allows more avoided deforestation than from integral protection, which bans clearing but seems feasible only further from deforestation threats. Based on our results, it seems that the political economy involved in siting such restrictions on production is likely to affect the ability of protected areas to reduce emissions from deforestation and degradation.
abstract_zh: 在巴西亚马逊的阿克雷州，我们发现，治理方式各异（包括对当地经济发展施加的不同约束）的保护类型，其选址也存在差异。考虑到这一点，我们估计了具有不同限制程度的这些保护类型的森林砍伐影响。为避免偏误，我们将这些受保护地点与在与森林砍伐相关的特征上相似的未受保护地点进行比较。我们发现，允许一定程度当地砍伐的可持续利用保护区，位于砍伐威胁较高的地点。这使其能够避免的森林砍伐多于完全保护区，后者禁止砍伐，但似乎只有在远离砍伐威胁的地方才具有可行性。基于我们的结果，对生产活动施加此类限制的选址所涉及的政治经济学，很可能会影响保护区减少毁林及森林退化所致排放的能力。

title: Impact of a randomized controlled trial in arsenic risk communication on household water-source choices in Bangladesh
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management 65 (2013) 225–240
abstract: We conducted a randomized controlled trial in rural Bangladesh to examine how household drinking-water choices were affected by two different messages about risk from naturally occurring groundwater arsenic. Households in both randomized treatment arms were informed about the arsenic level in their well and whether that level was above or below the Bangladesh standard for arsenic. Households in one group of villages were encouraged to seek water from wells below the national standard. Households in the second group of villages received additional information explaining that lower-arsenic well water is always safer and these households were encouraged to seek water from wells with lower levels of arsenic, irrespective of the national standard.A simple model of household drinking-water choice indicates that the effect of the emphasis message is theoretically ambiguous. Empirically, we find that the richer message had a negative, but insignificant, effect on well-switching rates, but the estimates are sufficiently precise that we can rule out large positive effects. The main policy implication of this finding is that a one-time oral message conveying richer information on arsenic risks, while inexpensive and easily scalable, is unlikely to be successful in reducing exposure relative to the status-quo policy.
abstract_zh: 我们在孟加拉国农村开展了一项随机对照试验，以考察两种关于天然地下水砷风险的不同信息如何影响家庭的饮用水选择。两个随机处理组的家庭都被告知其水井中的砷含量，以及该含量是高于还是低于孟加拉国的砷标准。其中一组村庄的家庭被鼓励从低于国家标准的水井取水。第二组村庄的家庭则额外获得了说明，即砷含量较低的井水总是更安全，并且这些家庭被鼓励从砷含量较低的水井取水，而不论其是否符合国家标准。一个简单的家庭饮用水选择模型表明，强调信息的效应在理论上是不确定的。从实证上看，我们发现，较丰富的信息对水井转换率的影响为负，但不显著，不过估计值足够精确，因此我们可以排除较大的正向效应。这一发现的主要政策含义是：一次性口头传达较丰富的砷风险信息，虽然成本低廉且易于推广，但相对于现行政策，它在降低暴露水平方面不太可能成功。

title: Improving stove evaluation using survey data: who received which intervention matters
abstract: As biomass fuel use in developing countries causes substantial harm to health and the environment, efficient stoves are candidates for subsidies to reduce emissions. In evaluating improved stoves’ relative benefits, little attention has been given to who received which stove intervention due to choices that are made by agencies and households. Using Chinese household data, we find that the owners of more efficient stoves (i.e., clean-fuel and improved-biomass stoves, as compared with traditional-biomass and coal stoves) live in less healthy counties and differ, across and within counties, in terms of household characteristics such as various assets. On net, that caused efficient stoves to look worse for health than they actually are. We control for counties and household characteristics in testing stove impacts. Unlike tests that lack controls, our preferred tests with controls suggest health benefits from clean-fuel versus traditional-biomass stoves. Also, they eliminate surprising estimates of health benefits from coal, found without using controls. Our results show the value, for learning, of tracking who gets which intervention.
abstract_zh: 由于发展中国家使用生物质燃料对健康和环境造成了严重危害，高效炉灶成为减排补贴的候选对象。在评估改良炉灶的相对效益时，很少有人关注由机构和家庭的选择所决定的谁获得了哪种炉灶干预。利用中国家庭数据，我们发现，高效炉灶（即与传统生物质炉灶及燃煤炉灶相比，清洁燃料炉灶和改良生物质炉灶）的拥有者所在县的健康状况较差，并且在县际和县内，他们在各类家庭特征（如各种资产）方面也存在差异。总体而言，这使得高效炉灶的健康效应看起来比实际情况更差。在检验炉灶影响时，我们控制了县级和家庭特征。与未加控制的检验不同，我们偏好的带控制变量的检验表明，相对于传统生物质炉灶，清洁燃料炉灶带来健康收益。此外，这些控制消除了在不使用控制变量时得到的、关于燃煤带来健康收益的令人惊讶的估计。我们的结果表明，追踪谁获得了哪种干预，对于学习和认识具有重要价值。

title: On the Endogeneity of Resource Comanagement: Theory and Evidence from Indonesia
abstract: We examine theoretically the emergence of participatory comanagement agreements that share between state and user the management of resources and the benefits from use. Going beyond useruser interactions, our state-user model addresses a critical question—when will comanagement arise?—in order to consider the right baseline for evaluating comanagement’s forest and welfare impacts. We then compare our model’s hypotheses concerning de facto rights, negotiated agreements, and transfers (all endogenous) with community-level data including observed agreements in a protected Indonesian forest. These unique data could refute the model, despite being limited, but instead offer support. (JEL Q28, Q57)
abstract_zh: 我们从理论上考察了参与式共同管理协议的出现，这类协议使国家与用户共同分享资源的管理权以及资源使用所带来的收益。超越用户与用户之间的互动，我们的国家—用户模型回答了一个关键问题——共同管理何时会出现？——从而为评估共同管理的森林和福利影响确定了合适的基准。随后，我们将模型关于事实权利、协商协议和转移支付（均为内生变量）的假设，与包括一个受保护的印度尼西亚森林中已观察到的协议在内的社区层面数据进行比较。尽管这些数据有限，但它们原本可能否定该模型，然而实际上却为其提供了支持。（JEL Q28, Q57）

title: Realistic REDD: Improving the Forest Impacts of Domestic Policies in Different Settings
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy, volume 7, issue 1, winter 2013, pp. 114–135
abstract: This article, which is part of a symposium on the economics of REDD, identifies three common settings for forest loss involving different types of decision-making agents that operate under different markets and institutions. That suggests using different theoretical frameworks for these three settings, which in turn generates different predictions concerning policies’ impacts. The first model, “producer profit maximization given market integration,” has been applied to many private decisions about the best locations for profitable land uses, such as agriculture and forest. Its predictions have been widely studied empirically, beginning no later than von Thunen (1826). The second model, “rural household optimization given incomplete markets and household heterogeneity,” has been applied to more isolated settings featuring high transactions costs that yield incomplete integration of households in input and output markets. Its policy impact predictions have been tested with surveys at household and village levels. In the third model, “public optimization given production and corruption responses by private firms,” a public agency determines public forest access by balancing public goods, public revenue needs, and private rents to award concessions. There is potential for corruption, and the decisions may be affected by decentralization. This model’s predictions can be tested using observed policies. We find that past policies rarely addressed the incentives driving forest loss effectively. This helps to explain the limited impact of past policies on deforestation and forest degradation. It also suggests directions for the design of future policies. In sum, the theory and the evidence suggest that REDD success requires an understanding of all the incentives that drive forest loss, so that domestic policy can be tailored to specific settings (i.e., relevant agents and institutions).
abstract_zh: 本文是关于REDD经济学专题研讨会的一部分，文中识别出三种常见的森林损失情境，涉及在不同市场和制度下运作的不同类型决策主体。这意味着应当针对这三种情境采用不同的理论框架，而这反过来又会产生关于政策影响的不同预测。第一个模型是“市场整合条件下的生产者利润最大化”，已被应用于许多关于盈利性土地用途（如农业和林业）最佳位置的私人决策，其预测自冯·杜能（von Thunen，1826）以来已被广泛研究。第二个模型是“不完全市场与家庭异质性条件下的农村家庭最优化”，已被应用于高交易成本、导致家庭在投入和产出市场中整合不完全的较为孤立的情境。其政策影响预测已通过家庭和村庄层面的调查得到检验。第三个模型是“私人企业生产与腐败反应条件下的公共最优化”，在该模型中，公共机构通过平衡公共物品、公共收入需求和私人租金来决定授予公共森林的准入权（特许经营权）。其中存在腐败的可能性，并且决策可能受到权力下放的影响。该模型的预测可以利用已观察到的政策进行检验。我们发现，过去的政策很少有效应对驱动森林损失的激励因素。这有助于解释过去政策对森林砍伐和森林退化的有限影响，也为未来政策的设计指明了方向。总之，理论与证据均表明，REDD的成功需要理解驱动森林损失的全部激励因素，从而使国内政策能够针对具体情境（即相关主体和制度）进行量身设计。

title: Unequal Information, Unequal Allocation: bargaining field experiments in NE Brazil
abstract: We assess how unequal information affects the bargaining within resource allocation, a stakeholder interaction that is critical for climate adaptation within the water sector. Motivated by water allocation among unequal actors in NE Brazil, within Ceara´ State, we employ ‘ultimatum’ field experiments in which one participant lacks information. We find that, despite having veto power, the less informed are vulnerable to inequity. When all are informed, we see a typical resource split (60% initiator–40% responder) that balances an initiator’s advantage with a responder’s willingness to punish greed. When instead responders have only a resource forecast upon which to base decisions, the fully informed initiators get 80% of resources for conditions of resource scarcity. Thus, despite each of the stakeholder types having an unquestioned ‘seat at the table’, information asymmetries make bargaining outcomes more unequal. Our results are widely relevant for adaptation involving the joint use of information, and suggest that equity can rise with dissemination of scientific outputs that are integral in adaptation.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了信息不对称如何影响资源分配中的讨价还价，这种利益相关方互动对水部门的气候适应至关重要。受巴西东北部塞阿拉州（Ceará）内各不平等行为体之间水资源分配问题的启发，我们开展了“最后通牒”田野实验，其中一名参与者缺乏信息。我们发现，尽管缺乏信息的一方拥有否决权，但他们仍然容易受到不平等的伤害。当所有人都掌握信息时，我们观察到典型的资源分配比例（提议者60%、响应者40%），这一比例在提议者的优势与响应者惩罚贪婪的意愿之间取得了平衡。而当响应者仅拥有资源预测作为决策依据时，在资源稀缺的条件下，掌握完全信息的提议者获得了80%的资源。因此，尽管每类利益相关者都毫无疑问地拥有“一席之地”，信息不对称仍会使讨价还价的结果更加不平等。我们的结果与涉及信息联合使用的适应问题广泛相关，并表明，随着科学产出的传播（这些产出是适应的核心组成部分），公平性可以得到提升。

title: Contagious Development: neighbor interactions in deforestation
abstract: We estimate neighbor interactions in deforestation in Costa Rica. To address simultaneity and the presence of spatially correlated unobservables, we measure for neighbors’ deforestation using the slopes of neighbors’ and neighbors’ neighbors’ parcels. We find that neighboring deforestation significantly raises the probability of deforestation. Policies for agricultural development or forest conservation in one area will affect deforestation rates in non-targeted neighboring areas. Correct estimation of the interaction reverses the naive estimate’s prediction of multiple equilibria.
abstract_zh: 我们估计了哥斯达黎加森林砍伐中的邻里互动。为了解决同时性问题以及存在空间相关的不可观测因素，我们利用邻近地块及邻近地块的邻近地块的坡度来衡量邻居的森林砍伐情况。我们发现，邻居的森林砍伐显著提高了本地块发生森林砍伐的概率。一个区域内的农业发展或森林保护政策，将会影响非目标邻近区域的森林砍伐率。对这种互动进行正确估计后，原本由朴素估计得出的多重均衡预测被推翻了。

title: Protecting forests, biodiversity, and the climate: predicting policy impact to improve policy choice
venue: Oxford Review of Economic Policy, Volume 28, Number 1, 2012, pp. 164–179
abstract: Policies must balance forest conservation’s local costs with its benefits—local to global—in terms of biodiversity, the mitigation of climate change, and other eco-services such as water quality. The trade-offs with development vary across forest locations. We argue that considering location in three ways helps to predict policy impact and improve policy choice: (i) policy impacts vary by location because baseline deforestation varies with characteristics (market distances, slopes, soils, etc.) of locations in a landscape; (ii) different mixes of political-economic pressures drive the location of different policies; and (iii) policies can trigger ‘second-order’ or ‘spillover’ effects likely to differ by location. We provide empirical evidence that suggests the importance of all three considerations, by reviewing high-quality evaluations of the impact of conservation and development on forest. Impacts of well-enforced conservation rise with private clearing pressure, supporting (i). Protection types (e.g. federal/state) differ in locations and thus in impacts, supporting (ii). Differences in development process explain different signs for spillovers, supporting (iii).
abstract_zh: 政策必须在森林保护的地方成本与其从地方到全球的效益（包括生物多样性、减缓气候变化以及水质等其他生态服务）之间取得平衡。与发展之间的权衡在不同森林位置之间存在差异。我们认为，从三个方面考虑位置有助于预测政策影响并改进政策选择：（i）由于基线森林砍伐随景观中各地的特征（市场距离、坡度、土壤等）而变化，政策影响也随位置而变化；（ii）不同的政治经济压力组合驱动着不同政策的选址；（iii）政策可能引发“二阶”或“溢出”效应，而这些效应可能因位置而异。通过回顾关于保护与发展对森林影响的高质量评估，我们提供了实证证据，表明上述三个方面均十分重要。受到有效执法的保护措施，其影响随私人砍伐压力的增加而上升，这支持了（i）。不同的保护类型（例如联邦级与州级）在选址上存在差异，因而影响也不同，这支持了（ii）。开发过程的差异解释了溢出效应符号的不同，这支持了（iii）。

title: The Advantage of Resource Queues over Spot Resource Markets: decision coordination in experiments under resource uncertainty
abstract: Farmers have to make key decisions, such as which crops to plant or whether to prepare the soil, before knowing how much water they will get. They face losses if they make costly decisions but do not receive water, and they may forego profits if they receive water without being prepared. We consider the coordination of farmers’ decisions, such as which crops to plant or whether to prepare the soil when farmers must divide an uncertain water supply. We compare ex‐ante queues (pre‐decision) to an ex‐post spot market (post‐decision & post‐rain) in experiments in rural Brazil and a university in England. Queues have greater coordination success than does the spot market.
abstract_zh: 农民必须在事先不知道能获得多少水的情况下做出关键决策，例如种植何种作物或是否整地。如果他们做出了代价高昂的决策，却没有得到水，就会蒙受损失；如果他们获得了水，却没有做好准备，又可能错失利润。在农民必须分割不确定的水源供应时，我们考察了其决策（如种植何种作物或是否整地）的协调问题。我们在巴西农村和英格兰的一所大学中开展实验，比较了事前排队（决策之前）与事后现货市场（决策之后且降雨之后）的效果。排队比现货市场更能成功地实现协调。

title: Assessing the impact of institutional design of Payments for Environmental Services: the Costa Rican experience
venue: B. Rapidel, F. DeClerk, J. LeCoq and J. Beer Eds. “Ecosystem services from Agriculture and Agroforestry: Measurement and Payment”. Chapter 14. Earthscan Press
abstract: in Costa Rica. The first years of implementation set the basis for what the programme has become. Important changes have been made since the beginning, such as the institution in charge of implementing the programme, parcels selection criteria, and new offices that were opened in different areas of the country with the objective of reducing application costs. Using 2003 as the starting point of when these changes took place, we discuss if they had a programme efficiency effect on reducing deforestation. We focus on forest conservation contracts because it is the most important category of the programme in terms of budget and amount of land enrolled. We use matching techniques, geographic information systems (GIS), characterize the areas where payments were implemented in each of the time periods using a long list of variables, and look for similar areas that did not receive payments. We find that, as other studies have found for this period (Robalino et al, 2008; Arriagada, 2008), the impacts are low but significant. While it seems that, overall, institutional changes have not had a significant effect on impact, we also look at the impacts of forest conservation contracts per office. We find that those offices located in areas with high deforestation tend to have higher impacts.
abstract_zh: （哥斯达黎加）该计划最初几年的实施为其后来的发展奠定了基础。自开始以来，计划做出了若干重要调整，例如负责实施该计划的机构、地块选择标准，以及为降低申请成本而在全国不同地区新设的办事处。我们以2003年为这些调整开始实施的时间节点，探讨这些调整是否提高了计划在减少森林砍伐方面的效率。我们重点关注森林保护合同，因为就预算和参与土地面积而言，它是该计划中最重要的类别。我们采用匹配技术和地理信息系统（GIS），利用大量变量刻画各时期获得补偿支付的地区，并寻找未获得补偿的相似地区。我们发现，与此前针对同一时期的其他研究一致（Robalino等，2008；Arriagada，2008），其影响较低，但具有统计显著性。总体而言，制度调整似乎并未对影响产生显著作用，但我们也考察了各办事处所辖森林保护合同的影响。我们发现，位于高砍伐地区的办事处往往具有更大的影响。

title: Can Environmental Insurance Succeed Where Other Strategies Fail? The case of underground storage tanks.
abstract: Private risk reduction will be socially efficient only when firms are liable for all the damage that they cause. We find that environmental insurance can achieve social efficiency even when two traditional policy instruments—ex post fines and risk management mandates with ex ante fines—do not. Inefficiency occurs with ex post fines, when small firms declare bankruptcy and escape their liabilities, limiting the incentives from this policy tool. Firms ignore mandates to implement efficient risk management because regulatory agencies do not have sufficient resources to monitor every firm. The evolution of the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency's and states’ underground storage tank programs suggests that mandating environmental insurance can address inefficiency due to small firms declaring bankruptcy. Comparing insurance mandates to risk management mandates, the burden on a regulator is lower if all it has to do is to confirm that the firm has insurance rather than that the firm has actually, and effectively, implemented required management practices. For underground storage tanks, we show that insurance lowered toxic releases.
abstract_zh: 只有当企业对其造成的全部损害承担责任时，私人风险降低才具有社会效率。我们发现，即使两种传统政策工具——事后罚款以及附带事前罚款的风险管理强制性规定——都无法实现社会效率，环境保险仍可以做到。当小企业宣布破产并逃避其责任时，事后罚款就会出现低效率，从而削弱这一政策工具的激励作用。由于监管机构没有足够资源监督每一家企业，企业会无视实施有效风险管理的强制性规定。美国环境保护署以及各州地下储油罐计划的演变表明，强制购买环境保险可以解决小企业破产所导致的低效率问题。比较保险强制性规定与风险管理强制性规定可以发现，如果监管者只需确认企业已投保，而不必确认企业是否真正有效地落实了规定的管理措施，其负担就更低。就地下储油罐而言，我们发现保险降低了有毒物质排放。

title: Demonstrating bias and improved inference for stoves' health benefits
abstract: BACKGROUND: Many studies associate health risks with household air pollution from biomass fuels and stoves. Evaluations of stove improvements can suffer from bias because they rarely address health-relevant differences between the households who get improvements and those who do not. METHODS: We demonstrate both the potential for bias and an option for improved stove inference by applying to household air pollution a technique used elsewhere in epidemiology, propensity-score matching (PSM), based on a stoves-and-health survey for China (15 counties, 3500 households). RESULTS: Health-relevant factors (age, wealth, kitchen ventilation) do in fact differ considerably between the households with stove improvements and those without. We study the resulting bias in estimates of cleaner-stove impacts using a self-reported Physical Component Summary (PCS). Typical stoves-literature regressions with little control for non-stove factors suggest no benefits from a cleaner-fuel stove relative to a traditional biomass stove. Yet increasing controls raises the impact estimates. Our PSM estimates address the differences in health-relevant factors using 'apples to apples' comparisons between those with improved stoves and 'similar' households. This generates higher estimates of clean-stove benefits, which are on the order of one half the standard deviation of the PCS outcome. CONCLUSIONS: Our data demonstrate the potential importance of bias in household air pollution studies. This results from failure to address the possibility that those receiving improved stoves are themselves prone to better or worse health outcomes. It suggests the value of data collection and of study design for cookstove interventions and, more generally, for policy interventions within many health outcomes.
abstract_zh: 背景：大量研究表明，生物质燃料和炉灶造成的家庭空气污染与健康风险相关。对炉灶改进效果的评估可能存在偏误，因为这些研究很少考虑获得改进炉灶的家庭与未获得改进的家庭在健康相关特征上的差异。方法：我们将流行病学中的一种技术——倾向得分匹配（PSM）——应用于家庭空气污染研究，以展示偏误的潜在可能性，并提出改进炉灶效果推断的一种方法。该分析基于一项针对中国的炉灶与健康调查（15个县，3500户家庭）。结果：健康相关因素（年龄、财富、厨房通风）在获得炉灶改进的家庭与未获得改进的家庭之间确实存在显著差异。我们利用自我报告的身体健康成分总结分（PCS）研究由此产生的偏误对清洁炉灶效果估计的影响。对非炉灶因素几乎未加控制的典型炉灶文献回归显示，相较于传统生物质炉灶，清洁燃料炉灶并无益处。然而，随着控制变量增加，效果估计值反而上升。我们的PSM估计通过将已改用改进炉灶的家庭与“相似”家庭进行“苹果对苹果”的比较，解决了健康相关因素的差异问题。这得出了更高的清洁炉灶效益估计，其大小约为PCS结果标准差的一半。结论：我们的数据表明，家庭空气污染研究中偏误可能非常重要。这源于未能考虑获得改进炉灶的家庭本身健康结果可能更好或更差的可能性。这说明在炉灶干预以及更广义的多种健康结果政策干预中，数据收集和研究设计具有重要价值。

title: Efficiency and equity in negotiated resource transfers: contributions and limitations of trust with limited contracts
abstract: We consider a case of water reallocation in Brazil, one which has numerous analogs elsewhere. To permit empirical study of the effects of institutions that can facilitate or restrict allocations, we conducted field experiments to explore trust’s potential when resource contracts are limited, using a novel asymmetric-productivity ultimatum game with a final surplus-sharing step added. As a form of informal institution, trust could in principle make rights and contracts unnecessary. We observe whether trust in compensation is in fact expected and expressed. We also explore whether trust is exploited, and the effect of communication, within our two bargaining structures: (1) no communication; and (2) with a non-binding message concerning the surplus to be shared. We see that our participants both expect and express trust that some of the surplus will be shared. Trust raises total output and some surplus is indeed shared: those who trust gain a bit on average; and the more trust was shown, the more was shared. However, often the trust was barely repaid. Further, the messages—found to help in other research—had little impact and were often untrue. In sum, trust does matter but both efficiency and equity could well rise with complete contracts.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了巴西的一个水资源再分配案例，此类情形在其他地方也有许多类似之处。为了对促进或限制资源配置的制度效果进行实证研究，我们开展了田野实验，在资源合同有限的情况下探究信任的潜力。实验采用了一种新颖的非对称生产率最后通牒博弈，并在其中加入了最终的剩余分配步骤。作为一种非正式制度，信任原则上可以使产权和合同变得不必要。我们观察补偿中的信任是否确实被预期和表达。我们还在两种谈判结构中考察信任是否被利用，以及沟通的作用：（1）无沟通；（2）有关待分配剩余的非约束性信息。我们发现，参与者既预期也表达了对部分剩余将被分享的信任。信任提高了总产出，且确实有部分剩余被分享：信任他人的人平均获得了少量收益；所表现出的信任越多，分享的部分也越多。然而，信任往往几乎没有得到回报。此外，在其他研究中被证明有效的信息沟通，在本研究中作用甚微，且内容常常不真实。总之，信任确实重要，但在完全合同的情况下，效率和公平都可能进一步提高。

title: Global protected area impacts
venue: Proceedings of the Royal Society B 2010
abstract: Protected areas (PAs) dominate conservation efforts. They will probably play a role in future climate policies too, as global payments may reward local reductions of loss of natural land cover. We estimate the impact of PAs on natural land cover within each of 147 countries by comparing outcomes inside PAs with outcomes outside. We use ‘matching’ (or ‘apples to apples’) for land characteristics to control for the fact that PAs very often are non-randomly distributed across their national landscapes. Protection tends towards land that, if unprotected, is less likely than average to be cleared. For 75 per cent of countries, we find protection does reduce conversion of natural land cover. However, for approximately 80 per cent of countries, our global results also confirm (following smaller-scale studies) that controlling for land characteristics reduces estimated impact by half or more. This shows the importance of controlling for at least a few key land characteristics. Further, we show that impacts vary considerably within a country (i.e. across a landscape): protection achieves less on lands far from roads, far from cities and on steeper slopes. Thus, while planners are, of course, constrained by other conservation priorities and costs, they could target higher impacts to earn more global payments for reduced deforestation.
abstract_zh: 保护区（PAs）在保护工作中占据主导地位。在未来的气候政策中，它们也很可能发挥作用，因为全球支付机制可能会对减少天然土地覆盖损失的地方性行动给予回报。我们在147个国家的范围内，通过比较保护区内与保护区外的结果，估计了保护区对天然土地覆盖的影响。我们采用“匹配”（即“苹果对苹果”）方法，对土地特征进行控制，因为保护区在国家版图上的分布往往并非随机。保护倾向于选择那些如果不加保护、被清理的可能性低于平均水平的土地。在75%的国家中，我们发现保护确实减少了天然土地覆盖的转换。然而，对于约80%的国家，我们的全球性结果也证实了（与较小规模研究一致）：控制土地特征会使估计的影响减少一半或更多。这表明控制至少若干关键土地特征的重要性。此外，我们还表明，影响在一个国家内部（即跨越不同地貌）差异很大：距离道路较远、距离城市较远以及坡度较陡的土地上，保护的成效更低。因此，尽管规划者当然受到其他保护优先事项和成本的约束，他们仍可以将更高影响的区域作为目标，以获得更多用于减少毁林的全球支付。

title: Indigenous Lands, Protected Areas, and Slowing Climate Change
abstract: Recent climate talks in Copenhagen reaffirmed the crucial role of reducing emissions from deforestation and degradation (REDD). Creating and strengthening indigenous lands and other protected areas represents an effective, practical, and immediate REDD strategy that addresses both biodiversity and climate crises at once.
abstract_zh: 哥本哈根近期的气候谈判再次确认了减少毁林和森林退化所致排放（REDD）的关键作用。设立并加强原住民土地和其他保护区，是一种有效、务实且迅速的REDD战略，能够同时应对生物多样性危机和气候危机。

title: Reassessing the forest impacts of protection: The challenge of nonrandom location and a corrective method
abstract: Protected areas are leading tools in efforts to slow global species loss and appear also to have a role in climate change policy. Understanding their impacts on deforestation informs environmental policies. We review several approaches to evaluating protection's impact on deforestation, given three hurdles to empirical evaluation, and note that “matching” techniques from economic impact evaluation address those hurdles. The central hurdle derives from the fact that protected areas are distributed nonrandomly across landscapes. Nonrandom location can be intentional, and for good reasons, including biological and political ones. Yet even so, when protected areas are biased in their locations toward less‐threatened areas, many methods for impact evaluation will overestimate protection's effect. The use of matching techniques allows one to control for known landscape biases when inferring the impact of protection. Applications of matching have revealed considerably lower impact estimates of forest protection than produced by other methods. A reduction in the estimated impact from existing parks does not suggest, however, that protection is unable to lower clearing. Rather, it indicates the importance of variation across locations in how much impact protection could possibly have on rates of deforestation. Matching, then, bundles improved estimates of the average impact of protection with guidance on where new parks’ impacts will be highest. While many factors will determine where new protected areas will be sited in the future, we claim that the variation across space in protection's impact on deforestation rates should inform site choice.
abstract_zh: 保护区是减缓全球物种丧失的主要工具，似乎在气候变化政策中也具有一定作用。了解其对毁林的影响有助于环境政策的制定。鉴于实证评估面临的三大障碍，我们回顾了评估保护对毁林影响的若干方法，并指出经济影响评估中的“匹配”技术可以应对这些障碍。核心障碍在于保护区在景观上的分布并非随机。非随机的选址可能是有意为之，且出于充分的理由，包括生物学和政治方面的理由。然而，即便如此，当保护区的选址偏向威胁较小的区域时，许多影响评估方法都会高估保护的效果。运用匹配技术，可以在推断保护的影响时控制已知的景观偏差。对森林保护的匹配应用表明，其影响估计值远低于其他方法得出的结果。然而，现有公园影响估计值的下降并不意味着保护无法遏制砍伐。相反，它表明了不同地点中保护可能对毁林率产生的影响存在差异，这一点十分重要。因此，匹配方法一方面提供了对保护平均影响的更准确估计，另一方面也为新公园影响最大的地点提供了指导。尽管未来新保护区的选址将由许多因素决定，但我们认为，保护对毁林率影响的空间差异应当为选址决策提供依据。

title: Regional Interdependence and Forest “Transitions”: substitute deforestation limits the relevance of local reversals
abstract: Using case studies and concepts we suggest that constraints upon aggregate or global forest transition are significantly more severe than those upon local forest reversals. The basic reason is that one region’s reversal can be facilitated by other regions that supply resources and goods, reducing the demands upon the region where forests rise. Many past forest reversals involve such interdependence. For ‘facilitating regions’ also to rise in forest requires other changes, since they will not be receiving such help. We start by discussing forest-transitions analysis within the context of Environmental Kuznets Curves (EKCs), for a useful typology of possible shifts underlying transitions. We then consider the historical Northeast US where a regional reversal was dramatic and impressive. Yet this depended upon agricultural price shocks, due to the Midwest US supplying food, and also upon the availability of timber from other US regions. Next we consider deforestation in Amazônia, whose history (like the Northeast US) suggests a potential local role for urbanization, i.e. spatial concentration of population. Yet inter-regional issues again are crucial. For cattle and soy, expansion of global demands may give to Amazonia a role more like the Midwest than the Northeast US. In addition, across-region interdependencies will help determine where reversal and facilitation occur. Finally we discuss the constraints upon very broad forest transition.
abstract_zh: 借助案例研究和相关概念，我们提出，相较于地方性的森林恢复，总体或全球性的森林转型所受的约束要严格得多。其根本原因在于，一个地区的森林恢复可以得益于其他地区提供资源和商品，从而减轻森林增加地区的需求压力。许多过去的森林恢复都涉及这种相互依赖。对于“提供支持的地区”而言，要实现森林增长同样需要其他方面的改变，因为它们将不再获得这种帮助。我们首先在环境库兹涅茨曲线（EKC）的框架内讨论森林转型分析，并借助一种有用的类型学来区分转型背后可能的各类转变。随后，我们考察历史上美国东北部的情况，那里的区域性森林恢复十分显著且引人注目。然而，这一恢复依赖于农产品价格冲击（由美国中西部提供粮食），也依赖于美国其他地区的木材供应。接下来，我们考察亚马孙地区的毁林问题。该地区的历史（与美国东北部类似）表明，城市化即人口空间集中可能发挥局部作用。然而，跨区域问题再次至关重要。对于牛肉和大豆，全球需求的扩张可能使亚马孙地区更类似于美国中西部，而非美国东北部。此外，跨区域的相互依赖将决定恢复与促进作用发生的地点。最后，我们讨论了非常宽泛意义上森林转型所受的约束。

title: Behavior, Environment, and Health in Developing Countries: evaluation and valuation
abstract: We consider health and environmental quality in developing countries, where limited resources constrain behaviors that combat enormously burdensome health challenges. We focus on four huge challenges that are preventable (i.e., are resolved in rich countries). We distinguish them as special cases in a general model of household behavior, which is critical and depends on risk information. Simply informing households may achieve a lot in the simplest challenge (groundwater arsenic); yet, for the three infectious situations discussed (respiratory, diarrhea, and malaria), community coordination and public provision may also be necessary. More generally, social interactions may justify additional policies. For each situation, we discuss the valuation of private spillovers (i.e., externalities) and evaluation of public policies to reduce environmental risks and spillovers. Finally, we reflect on open questions in our model and knowledge gaps in the empirical literature including the challenges of scaling up and climate change.
abstract_zh: 我们考察发展中国家的健康与环境质量问题。在这些国家，有限的资源制约了人们应对沉重健康挑战的行为。我们聚焦于四类巨大且可预防（即在富裕国家已被解决）的挑战。我们将其作为家庭行为一般模型中的特例加以区分，而家庭行为具有关键作用，并取决于风险信息。在最简单的挑战（地下水砷污染）中，仅仅向家庭提供信息可能就能取得很大成效；然而，对于所讨论的三种传染性情形（呼吸道疾病、腹泻和疟疾），社区协调和公共供给可能也是必要的。更一般地，社会互动可能为额外的政策提供依据。针对每种情形，我们讨论了私人外部性（即外溢效应）的估值，以及减少环境风险和外溢效应的公共政策评估。最后，我们对模型中的开放性问题以及实证文献中的知识缺口进行了反思，包括扩大规模的挑战和气候变化问题。

title: High and Far: Biases in the Location of Protected Areas
abstract: BACKGROUND: About an eighth of the earth's land surface is in protected areas (hereafter "PAs"), most created during the 20(th) century. Natural landscapes are critical for species persistence and PAs can play a major role in conservation and in climate policy. Such contributions may be harder than expected to implement if new PAs are constrained to the same kinds of locations that PAs currently occupy. METHODOLOGY/PRINCIPAL FINDINGS: Quantitatively extending the perception that PAs occupy "rock and ice", we show that across 147 nations PA networks are biased towards places that are unlikely to face land conversion pressures even in the absence of protection. We test each country's PA network for bias in elevation, slope, distances to roads and cities, and suitability for agriculture. Further, within each country's set of PAs, we also ask if the level of protection is biased in these ways. We find that the significant majority of national PA networks are biased to higher elevations, steeper slopes and greater distances to roads and cities. Also, within a country, PAs with higher protection status are more biased than are the PAs with lower protection statuses. CONCLUSIONS/SIGNIFICANCE: In sum, PAs are biased towards where they can least prevent land conversion (even if they offer perfect protection). These globally comprehensive results extend findings from nation-level analyses. They imply that siting rules such as the Convention on Biological Diversity's 2010 Target [to protect 10% of all ecoregions] might raise PA impacts if applied at the country level. In light of the potential for global carbon-based payments for avoided deforestation or REDD, these results suggest that attention to threat could improve outcomes from the creation and management of PAs.
abstract_zh: 背景：地球陆地表面约有八分之一位于保护区（以下简称“PAs”）之内，其中大部分设立于20世纪。自然景观对物种延续至关重要，保护区在保护和气候政策中都能发挥重要作用。然而，如果新保护区的选址仍局限于现有保护区所处的同类地点，这些贡献的实现可能比预期更为困难。方法/主要发现：我们定量地拓展了保护区“只占据岩石和冰川”这一观点，表明在147个国家中，保护区网络偏向于那些即使没有保护也不太可能面临土地转换压力的地方。我们检验了每个国家的保护区网络在海拔、坡度、距道路和城市的距离以及农业适宜性方面是否存在偏差。此外，在每个国家的保护区内部，我们还考察了保护水平是否在这些方面存在偏差。我们发现，绝大多数国家的保护区网络偏向于较高海拔、较陡坡度以及距离道路和城市较远的地方。同时，在一国之内，保护级别较高的保护区比保护级别较低的保护区存在更大的偏差。结论/意义：总之，保护区偏向于那些即使提供完美保护也最难防止土地转换的地方。这些全球性的综合结果扩展了国家层面分析的发现。它们表明，若在国家层面应用《生物多样性公约》2010年目标中的选址规则（即保护每个生态区10%的面积），可能会提高保护区的影响。鉴于全球范围内可能出现的以碳为基础的避免毁林支付或REDD机制，这些结果表明，关注威胁因素有助于改善保护区的设立与管理成效。

title: Human choices and policies' impacts on ecosystem services: improving evaluations of payment and park effects on conservation and carbon
venue: Engel, S. and C. Palmer, editors, “Avoided Deforestation: Prospects for Mitigating Climate Change”, Routledge Explorations in Environmental Economics 2009
abstract: Alexander Pfaff and Juan Robalino Introduction Conservation policies are receiving increased attention in light of the potential, under new climate change policies, for rewarding avoided deforestation. Deforestation could be avoided in many ways, from alterations of development policies through many forms of conservation, for example, the creation of protected areas. In particular, the potential of payments for environmental services has received significant attention of late (see Chomitz et al., 1999; Echavarria et al., 2004; Frank and Muller, 2003; Miranda et al., 2003; Rojas and Aylward, 2003; Rosales, 2003; Smith, 1995; Szentandrasi et al., 1995; Tikka, 2003) and it is a focus of this volume and chapter.
abstract_zh: Alexander Pfaff与Juan Robalino 引言 鉴于在新的气候变化政策下可能对避免毁林给予回报，保护政策正受到越来越多的关注。毁林可以通过多种方式避免，包括调整发展政策，以及多种形式的保护，例如设立保护区。尤其是，环境服务付费的潜力近来受到了广泛关注（参见Chomitz等，1999；Echavarria等，2004；Frank和Muller，2003；Miranda等，2003；Rojas和Aylward，2003；Rosales，2003；Smith，1995；Szentandrasi等，1995；Tikka，2003），本卷及本章也将其作为重点。

title: Park Location Affects Forest Protection: Land Characteristics Cause Differences in Park Impacts across Costa Rica
venue: The B.E. Journal of Economic Analysis & Policy: Vol. 9: Iss. 2 (Contributions), Article 5
abstract: To support conservation planning, we ask whether a park's impact on deforestation rates varies with observable land characteristics that planners could use to prioritize sites. Using matching methods to address bias from non-random location, we find deforestation impacts vary greatly due to park lands' characteristics. Avoided deforestation is greater if parks are closer to the capital city, in sites closer to national roads, and on lower slopes. In allocating scarce conservation resources, policy makers may consider many factors such as the ecosystem services provided by a site and the costs of acquiring the site. Pfaff and Sanchez 2004 claim impact can rise with a focus upon threatened land, all else equal. We provide empirical support in the context of Costa Rica's renowned park system. This insight, alongside information on eco-services and land costs, should guide investments.
abstract_zh: 为支持保护规划，我们考察公园对毁林率的影响是否随规划者可用于确定优先地点的可观测土地特征而变化。运用匹配方法消除非随机选址所带来的偏差，我们发现，公园的毁林影响因公园土地特征的不同而差异很大。若公园距离首都更近、位于靠近国道的地点，或坡度较低，则避免的毁林量更大。在分配稀缺的保护资源时，政策制定者可能需要考虑多种因素，例如某一地点提供的生态系统服务以及获取该地点的成本。Pfaff和Sanchez（2004）提出，在其他条件相同的情况下，关注受威胁土地可以提高影响。我们以哥斯达黎加著名的公园体系为背景提供了实证支持。这一认识连同有关生态服务和土地成本的信息，应当指导相关投资。

title: Effects of Poverty on Deforestation: distinguishing behavior from location
venue: Economics of poverty, environment and natural resource use (chapter 6)
abstract: We review many theoretical predictions that link poverty to deforestation and then examine poverty’s net impact empirically using multiple observations of all of Costa Rica after 1960. Countrywide disaggregate (district-level) data facilitate analysis of both poverty’s location and its impact on forest. If the characteristics of the places the poor live are not controlled for, then poverty’s impact is confounded with differences between poorer and less poor areas and we find no significant effect of poverty. Using our data over space and time to control for effects of locations’ differing characteristics, we find that the poorer are on land whose relative quality discourages forest clearing, such that with these controls the poorer areas are cleared more. The latter result suggests that poverty reduction aids the forest. For the poorest areas, this result is weaker but another effect is found: deforestation responds less to productivity, i.e., the poorest have less ability to expand or to reduce given land quality.
abstract_zh: 我们回顾了许多将贫困与毁林联系起来的理论预测，并利用1960年以后哥斯达黎加全境的多期观测数据，对贫困的净影响进行了实证检验。全国范围的分类（区级）数据有助于同时分析贫困的地点分布及其对森林的影响。如果不控制贫困人口所居住地点的特征，那么贫困的影响将与较贫困地区和较不贫困地区之间的差异相混淆，我们也确实发现贫困的影响并不显著。利用跨空间和跨时间的数据来控制各地不同特征的影响，我们发现，较贫困人口所处的土地，其相对质量抑制了森林砍伐，因此在控制这些因素之后，较贫困地区的砍伐反而更多。后一结果表明，减少贫困有助于森林保护。对于最贫困的地区，这一结果较弱，但还发现了另一种效应：毁林对生产率的反应较弱，即最贫困者扩大或减少既定土地质量下生产的能力较弱。

title: Measuring the effectiveness of protected-area networks in reducing deforestation
abstract: Global efforts to reduce tropical deforestation rely heavily on the establishment of protected areas. Measuring the effectiveness of these areas is difficult because the amount of deforestation that would have occurred in the absence of legal protection cannot be directly observed. Conventional methods of evaluating the effectiveness of protected areas can be biased because protection is not randomly assigned and because protection can induce deforestation spillovers (displacement) to neighboring forests. We demonstrate that estimates of effectiveness can be substantially improved by controlling for biases along dimensions that are observable, measuring spatial spillovers, and testing the sensitivity of estimates to potential hidden biases. We apply matching methods to evaluate the impact on deforestation of Costa Rica's renowned protected-area system between 1960 and 1997. We find that protection reduced deforestation: approximately 10% of the protected forests would have been deforested had they not been protected. Conventional approaches to evaluating conservation impact, which fail to control for observable covariates correlated with both protection and deforestation, substantially overestimate avoided deforestation (by over 65%, based on our estimates). We also find that deforestation spillovers from protected to unprotected forests are negligible. Our conclusions are robust to potential hidden bias, as well as to changes in modeling assumptions. Our results show that, with appropriate empirical methods, conservation scientists and policy makers can better understand the relationships between human and natural systems and can use this to guide their attempts to protect critical ecosystem services.
abstract_zh: 全球减少热带毁林的努力在很大程度上依赖于设立保护区。衡量这些保护区的成效十分困难，因为在没有法律保护的情况下本会发生的毁林量无法直接观测。传统的保护区成效评估方法可能存在偏误，原因在于保护的分配并非随机，且保护可能引发毁林外溢（转移）至邻近森林。我们表明，通过控制可观测维度上的偏误、测度空间外溢效应，并检验估计结果对潜在隐性偏误的敏感性，可以显著改进成效估计。我们运用匹配方法评估了1960年至1997年间哥斯达黎加著名保护区体系对毁林的影响。我们发现，保护减少了毁林：大约10%的受保护森林在未受保护的情况下将被砍伐。传统的保护影响评估方法未能控制那些与保护和毁林同时相关的可观测协变量，从而大幅高估了避免的毁林量（根据我们的估计，高估幅度超过65%）。我们还发现，从受保护森林到未受保护森林的毁林外溢效应可以忽略不计。我们的结论对潜在的隐性偏误以及模型设定的变化都是稳健的。我们的结果表明，借助恰当的实证方法，保护科学家和政策制定者能够更好地理解人类系统与自然系统之间的关系，并以此指导他们保护关键生态系统服务的努力。
