title: Can information alone change behavior? Response to arsenic contamination of groundwater in Bangladesh
abstract: We study how effectively information induces Bangladeshi households to avoid a health risk. The response to information is large and rapid; knowing that the household’s well water has an unsafe concentration of arsenic raises the probability that the household changes to another well within one year by 0.37. Households who change wells increase the time spent obtaining water fifteen-fold. We identify a causal effect of information, since incidence of arsenic is uncorrelated with household characteristics. Our door-to-door information campaign provides well-specific arsenic levels without which behavior does not change. Media communicate general information about arsenic less expensively and no less effectively.
abstract_zh: 我们研究信息能在多大程度上有效地促使孟加拉国家庭规避健康风险。对信息的反应既大又迅速：得知家庭水井中砷的浓度不安全，会使该家庭在一年内改用另一口水井的概率提高0.37。改用水井的家庭，取水所花费的时间增加了十五倍。由于砷的发生率与家庭特征不相关，我们识别出了信息的因果效应。我们挨家挨户开展的信息宣传活动提供了每口井的具体砷含量，没有这些信息，行为便不会改变。大众媒体传播有关砷的一般性信息，成本更低，效果也不逊色。

title: Climate, Stream Flow Prediction and Water Management in Northeast Brazil: societal trends and forecast value
abstract: We assess the potential benefits from innovative forecasts of the stream flows that replenish reservoirs in the semi-arid state of Ceará, Brazil. Such forecasts have many potential applications. In Ceará, they matter for both water-allocation and participatory-governance issues that echo global debates. Our qualitative analysis, based upon extensive fieldwork with farmers, agencies, politicians and other key actors in the water sector, stresses that forecast value changes as a society shifts. In the case of Ceará, current constraints on the use of these forecasts are likely to be reduced by shifts in water demand, water allocation in the agricultural Jaguaribe Valley, participatory processes for water allocation between this valley and the capital city of Fortaleza, and risk perception. Such changes in the water sector can also have major distributional impacts.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了为巴西半干旱州塞阿拉（Ceará）水库补水的河川径流创新预测所能带来的潜在收益。此类预测具有许多潜在应用。在塞阿拉，预测既关系到水资源配置问题，也关系到参与式治理问题，这与全球性的相关讨论相呼应。我们的定性分析基于对农民、机构、政治人物及水利部门其他关键行动者的大量田野调查，强调预测的价值会随着社会的转变而变化。就塞阿拉而言，当前对这些预测使用的限制，有望因用水需求的变化、阿贝斯·雅瓜里贝河谷（Jaguaribe Valley）农业用水分配的变化、该河谷与首府福塔莱萨（Fortaleza）之间用水分配的参与式过程，以及风险认知的变化而有所缓解。水利部门的此类变化也可能产生重大的分配影响。

title: Costa Rica’s Payment for Environmental Services Program: Intention, Implementation, and Impact
abstract: We evaluated the intention, implementation, and impact of Costa Rica's program of payments for environmental services (PSA), which was established in the late 1990s. Payments are given to private landowners who own land in forest areas in recognition of the ecosystem services their land provides. To characterize the distribution of PSA in Costa Rica, we combined remote sensing with geographic information system databases and then used econometrics to explore the impacts of payments on deforestation. Payments were distributed broadly across ecological and socioeconomic gradients, but the 1997–2000 deforestation rate was not significantly lower in areas that received payments. Other successful Costa Rican conservation policies, including those prior to the PSA program, may explain the current reduction in deforestation rates. The PSA program is a major advance in the global institutionalization of ecosystem investments because few, if any, other countries have such a conservation history and because much can be learned from Costa Rica's experiences.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了哥斯达黎加环境服务付费计划（PSA）的意图、实施与影响，该计划设立于20世纪90年代末。付费发放给在森林地区拥有土地的私人土地所有者，以表彰其土地所提供的生态系统服务。为刻画哥斯达黎加PSA的分布情况，我们将遥感与地理信息系统数据库相结合，并运用计量经济学方法考察付费对森林砍伐的影响。付费在生态和社会经济梯度上分布较为广泛，但在获得付费的地区，1997–2000年的森林砍伐率并未显著更低。哥斯达黎加其他成功的保护政策（包括PSA计划实施之前的政策）可能解释了当前森林砍伐率的下降。PSA计划是全球生态系统投资制度化进程中的一大进步，因为很少（如果有的话）其他国家拥有如此悠久的保护历史，并且可以从哥斯达黎加的经验中学到很多东西。

title: Estimating Spatial Interactions in Deforestation Decisions
venue: Frontiers of Biodiversity Economics, Cambridge University Press
abstract: Introduction Ongoing decreases in the stock of tropical forest have long been a major concern, due to their implications for biodiversity loss and provision of ecosystem services. Ecological research also provides evidence that even if the stock is held constant, the spatial pattern of forest affects the level of services generated (McCoy and Mushinsky 1994; Twedt and Loesch 1999; Diaz et al. 2000; Parkhurst et al . 2002; Coops et al . 2004; Scull and Harman 2004). A highly fragmented forest made up of small patches may not provide the minimum habitat size that some organisms require. Thus it may offer less protection for species than the same amount of unfragmented forest. It is then important to understand the effects of human activities that fragment standing forest and, as a result, alter the size, the shape, and also the spatial arrangement of habitat. These properties of habitat affect extinction rates of local populations. Standard economic models of rural land use (e.g. agriculture/forest frontiers) will generate predictions of spatial pattern down to the level of detail that their data permit. However, a focus on spatial pattern highlights a question these models do not address: are there spatial dynamics per se ? If we look behind observed spatial correlation, do one's land-use choices actually have any causal impacts upon those made by one's neighbours? This chapter presents a model of such spatial interactions and then discusses a method to empirically test for their presence using observed deforestation behaviour.
abstract_zh: 引言 热带森林存量的持续减少长期以来一直是重大关切，因为这关系到生物多样性丧失和生态系统服务的供给。生态学研究还表明，即使森林存量保持不变，森林的空间格局也会影响所产生服务的水平（McCoy和Mushinsky，1994；Twedt和Loesch，1999；Diaz等，2000；Parkhurst等，2002；Coops等，2004；Scull和Harman，2004）。由小斑块构成的高度破碎化的森林，可能无法提供某些生物所需的最小栖息地面积。因此，与同等面积的未破碎森林相比，它对物种的保护作用可能更弱。由此，理解那些使现存森林破碎化、从而改变栖息地的大小、形状及空间布局的人类活动十分重要。栖息地的这些特性会影响局部种群的灭绝率。标准的农村土地利用经济学模型（例如农业/森林边界模型）会根据数据所允许的细节程度，预测空间格局。然而，关注空间格局凸显了这些模型未能回答的一个问题：是否存在空间动态本身？如果我们透过观察到的空间相关性去探究，一个人的土地利用选择是否真的会对邻居的选择产生因果影响？本章提出了这种空间互动的模型，随后讨论一种利用观测到的毁林行为来实证检验其存在的方法。

title: Payments for Ecosystem Services: why precision and targeting matter
abstract: Even a perfect measure of the ecosystem services provided by each parcel enrolled in a PES program would be insufficient to measure the overall effectiveness of the program. The simple reason is that if a PES program does not lead to an increase in the provision of ecosystem services compared to what would have happened in the absence of the program—that is, the baseline or “counterfactual”—then it has not accomplished anything. Imagine a PES program focused on forest conservation that makes payments to managers of ecologically rich forest land, who have no incentive to clear the land because it is illsuited for logging, agriculture, or urbanization. Payments to these managers would have little impact on deforestation because the risk of clearing was minimal to begin with. In contrast, payments to managers who have incentives to clear their land would be much more likely to have an impact.
abstract_zh: 即使能够完美度量PES计划中每个登记地块所提供的生态系统服务，也不足以衡量该计划的整体成效。原因很简单：如果PES计划没有使生态系统服务的供给相对于没有该计划时（即基线或“反事实”情形）有所增加，那么它就没有取得任何成效。设想一个以森林保护为重点的PES计划，它向生态价值丰富的林地管理者付款，而这些管理者没有砍伐的动机，因为这些土地不适合伐木、农业或城市化。对这些管理者付款对毁林的影响将微乎其微，因为原本砍伐的风险就很小。相反，向那些有动机砍伐自己土地的管理者付款，则更有可能产生影响。

title: Reduction in Urinary Arsenic Levels in Response to Arsenic Mitigation Efforts in Araihazar, Bangladesh
venue: Environmental Health Perspectives, Vol. 115, No. 6 (Jun., 2007), pp. 917-923
abstract:
There is a need to identify and evaluate an effective mitigation program for arsenic exposure from drinking water in Bangladesh.
We evaluated the effectiveness of a multifaceted mitigation program to reduce As exposure among 11,746 individuals in a prospective cohort study initiated in 2000 in Araihazar, Bangladesh, by interviewing participants and measuring changes in urinary As levels.
The interventions included a) person-to-person reporting of well test results and health education; b) well labeling and village-level health education; and c) installations of 50 deep, low-As community wells in villages with the highest As exposure.
Two years after these interventions, 58% of the 6,512 participants with unsafe wells (As ≥50 μg) at baseline had responded by switching to other wells. Well labeling and village-level health education was positively related to switching to safe wells (As < 50 μg/L) among participants with unsafe wells [rate ratio (RR) = 1.84; 95% confidence interval (CI), 1.60–2.11] and inversely related to any well switching among those with safe wells (RR = 0.80; 95% CI, 0.66–0.98). The urinary As level in participants who switched to a well identified as safe (< 50 μg As/L) dropped from an average of 375 μg As/g creatinine to 200 μg As/g creatinine, a 46% reduction toward the average urinary As content of 136 μg As/g creatinine for participants that used safe wells throughout. Urinary As reduction was positively related to educational attainment, body mass index, never-smoking, absence of skin lesions, and time since switching (p for trend < 0.05).
Our study shows that testing of wells and informing households of the consequences of As exposure, combined with installation of deep community wells where most needed, can effectively address the continuing public health emergency from arsenic in drinking water in Bangladesh.
abstract_zh:
孟加拉国亟需识别并评估一项有效的饮用水砷暴露缓解计划。
我们在阿拉伊哈扎尔（Araihazar，孟加拉国）于2000年启动的前瞻性队列研究中，评估了一项多方面缓解计划对减少11,746名个体砷暴露的有效性，方法是访谈参与者并测量其尿液中砷含量的变化。干预措施包括：a）点对点报告水井检测结果并开展健康教育；b）为水井贴标签并开展村级健康教育；c）在砷暴露最严重的村庄安装50口深层低砷社区水井。干预两年后，在基线时使用不安全水井（砷≥50 μg）的6,512名参与者中，有58%已通过改用其他水井作出应对。在使用不安全水井的参与者中，水井标签和村级健康教育与改用安全水井呈正相关 [比率比（RR）= 1.84；95%置信区间（CI），1.60–2.11]；而在使用安全水井的参与者中，它们与任何改用水井的行为呈负相关（RR = 0.80；95% CI，0.66–0.98）。改用被标识为安全（砷<50 μg/L）水井的参与者，其尿液砷含量从平均每克肌酐375 μg砷降至200 μg砷，降幅为46%，并趋向于全程使用安全水井的参与者平均每克肌酐136 μg砷的水平。尿液砷的降低与教育程度、体重指数、从不吸烟、无皮肤损伤以及改用水井后的时间呈正相关（趋势检验 p < 0.05）。我们的研究表明，对水井进行检测并告知家庭砷暴露的后果，同时在最需要之处安装深层社区水井，能够有效应对孟加拉国饮用水砷污染这一持续存在的公共卫生紧急状况。

title: Responses of 6500 households to arsenic mitigation in Araihazar, Bangladesh
abstract: This study documents the response of 6500 rural households in a 25 km2 area of Bangladesh to interventions intended to reduce their exposure to arsenic contained in well water. The interventions included public education, posting test results for arsenic on the wells, and installing 50 community wells. Sixty-five percent of respondents from the subset of 3410 unsafe wells changed their source of drinking water, often to new and untested wells. Only 15% of respondents from the subset of safe wells changed their source, indicating that health concerns motivated the changes. The geo-referenced data indicate that distance to the nearest safe well also influenced household responses.
abstract_zh: 本研究记录了孟加拉国一个25平方公里地区6500户农村家庭对旨在减少其井水砷暴露的干预措施的反应。干预措施包括公众教育、在水井上张贴砷检测结果，以及安装50口社区水井。在3410口不安全水井的子样本中，有65%的受访者改变了饮用水来源，且通常改用新的、未经检测的水井。在安全水井的子样本中，只有15%的受访者改变了水源，这表明改变行为主要出于健康方面的考虑。地理定位数据表明，到最近安全水井的距离也影响了家庭的反应。

title: Road Investments, Spatial Spillovers and Deforestation in the Brazilian Amazon
venue: Journal of Regional Science 2007 volume 47, no. 1, 2007, pp. 109–123
abstract: Understanding the impact of road investments on deforestation is part of a complete evaluation of the expansion of infrastructure for development. We find evidence of spatial spillovers from roads in the Brazilian Amazon: deforestation rises in the census tracts that lack roads but are in the same county as and within 100 km of a tract with a new paved or unpaved road. At greater distances from the new roads the evidence is mixed, including negative coefficients of inconsistent significance between 100 and 300 km, and if anything, higher neighbor deforestation at distances over 300 km.
abstract_zh: 理解道路投资对毁林的影响，是全面评估发展基础设施扩张的一部分。我们发现巴西亚马孙地区道路存在空间外溢效应：在与新建的铺装或未铺装道路所在普查区位于同一县、距离在100公里以内、但自身无道路的普查区中，毁林增加。在更远的距离上，证据则较为混杂，包括在100至300公里之间存在显著性不一致的负系数，以及在超过300公里时，邻近地区的毁林程度即使有所上升，也较为有限。

title: Will buying tropical forest carbon benefit the poor? evidence from Costa Rica
abstract: We review claims linking both payments for carbon and poverty to deforestation. We examine these effects empirically for Costa Rica during the late 20th century using an econometric approach that addresses the irreversibilities in deforestation. We find significant effects of the relative returns to forest on deforestation rates. Thus, carbon payments would induce conservation and also carbon sequestration, and if land users were poor could conserve forest while addressing rural poverty. We note that the poor appear to be marginalized in the sense of living where land profitability is lower. Those areas also have more forest. We find that poorer areas may have a higher supply response to payments, but even without this effect poor areas might be included and benefit more due to higher (per capita) forest area. They might be included less due to transactions costs, though. Unless the Clean Development Mechanism of the Kyoto Protocol is modified in its implementation to allow credits from avoided deforestation, such benefits are likely to be limited.
abstract_zh: 我们回顾了将碳支付和贫困都与毁林联系起来的各种观点。我们运用一种能够处理毁林不可逆性的计量经济学方法，对20世纪末哥斯达黎加的情况进行了实证检验。我们发现，森林相对收益对毁林率具有显著影响。因此，碳支付将促进保护并增加碳汇；如果土地使用者贫困，碳支付既能保护森林，又能缓解农村贫困。我们注意到，贫困人口似乎处于边缘地位，即居住在土地收益较低的地区。这些地区的森林也更多。我们发现，较贫困地区对支付的供给反应可能更高，但即使没有这一效应，贫困地区仍可能因人均森林面积较大而被纳入计划并获得更多收益。然而，由于交易成本的存在，它们也可能被纳入得较少。除非《京都议定书》的清洁发展机制在实施中做出修改，允许对避免毁林产生的碳信用进行抵扣，否则此类收益可能十分有限。

Aid, economic growth and environmental sustainability: rich-poor interactions and environmental choices in developing countries
venue: Int. J. Global Environmental Issues (2004) volume 4 numbers 1/2/3: 139-159
abstract: Rich-poor interactions complicate the search for a stable Environmental Kuznets Curve (an "inverted U" relationship between income per-capita and environmental degradation). We show that aid from richer to poorer countries to support investments in environment, in either of two forms, alters the income-environment relationships that otherwise exist, lowering levels of degradation in the poorer countries conditional upon their incomes. Yet even with environmental aid, in our model, environmental quality eventually falls as economic growth continues, although ongoing innovation could change that conclusion. In light of this result, we show that subsidies to clean goods, one form of technological-transfer aid programme, dominate income transfers as environmental aid policy by the rich. Given that aid matters, we then show that when rich countries degrade the environment, a perverse effect exists: when an aid-giving country becomes richer, it gives less said to the poor country. This is stronger when that degradation is durable, that is, when consumption and degradation by the rich country in the past has durable effects upon the environment.
abstract_zh: 富国与穷国之间的相互作用，使寻找稳定的环境库兹涅茨曲线（即人均收入与环境退化之间的“倒U形”关系）变得复杂。我们表明，富国向穷国提供援助以支持环境投资（以两种形式中的任一种），会改变原本存在的收入与环境之间的关系，在给定收入水平的条件下，降低穷国的环境退化水平。然而，即使有环境援助，在我们的模型中，随着经济增长持续，环境质量最终仍会下降，尽管持续的创新可能会改变这一结论。鉴于此结果，我们表明，对清洁产品的补贴（技术转移援助计划的一种形式）作为富国的环境援助政策，优于收入转移。鉴于援助确实重要，我们进一步表明，当富国破坏环境时，会出现一种反常效应：当提供援助的国家变得更富有时，它给予贫困国家的援助反而更少。当这种退化具有持久性时，即富国过去的消费和退化对环境具有持久影响时，这一效应更加明显。

title: Big Field, Small Potatoes: an empirical assessment of EPA's Self-Audit Policy
venue: Journal of Policy Analysis and Management (2004) volume 23 number 3: 415–432
abstract: Environmental self-auditing by private firms is generally thought to both deserve and require encouragement. Firms can audit themselves more cheaply and effectively than can regulators, but too often are deterred for fear that the information they uncover will be used against them. To reduce this disincentive, the EPA's Audit Policy lowers punitive fines when firms promptly disclose and correct violations that they themselves discover. While some contend that the Audit Policy is inadequate, EPA touts its success, presenting as evidence the policy's track record to date. Yet our examination of that track record leads us to question EPA's conclusions. While the policy appears to have encouraged firms to self-audit in a number of instances, a comparison of the violations uncovered in these cases with those detected by standard enforcement practices suggests that the typical self-audited violation is relatively minor. For instance, cases arising under the Audit Policy are more likely to concern reporting violations, rather than emissions. The relative insignificance of self-audited violations raises a number of broader policy questions, including whether the Audit Policy could and should be revised to play a larger role in regulatory enforcement.
abstract_zh: 私人企业的环境自查通常被认为既值得鼓励，也需要鼓励。企业自查比监管机构更便宜、更有效，但由于担心其发现的信息会被用来对付自己，企业往往望而却步。为减少这种阻碍，美国环境保护署的《自查政策》在企业迅速披露并纠正自行发现的违规行为时，降低惩罚性罚款。虽然有人认为《自查政策》不够充分，但美国环境保护署对其成效大加推崇，并以该政策迄今的记录作为证据。然而，我们对这一记录的考察使我们对环境保护署的结论产生了怀疑。尽管该政策在一些案例中似乎确实鼓励了企业自查，但将这些案例中发现的违规行为与标准执法实践所查出的违规行为进行比较后发现，典型的自查违规行为相对较为轻微。例如，依据《自查政策》处理的案件更多涉及报告违规，而非排放问题。自查违规的相对轻微性引出了一些更广泛的政策问题，包括该《自查政策》是否可以，以及是否应当加以修订，以在监管执法中发挥更大的作用。

title: Deforestation pressure and biological reserve planning: a conceptual approach and an illustrative application for Costa Rica
abstract: An index of ‘deforestation pressure’ is suggested as useful for reserve planning alongside the currently used information on the species present at candidate sites. For any location, the index value is correlated with threats to habitat and thus also survival probabilities over time for members of species dependent on that habitat. Threats in the absence of reserves are key information for planning new reserves. The index is estimated using a regression approach derived from a dynamic, micro-economic model of land use, with data on observed clearing of forest over space and time as well as biophysical and socioeconomic factors in land returns. Applying an estimated threat (or probability of clearing) function for Costa Rica to locations of interest yields relevant estimates of sites’ deforestation pressure, which are used to evaluate proposed reserves and to suggest other candidate sites.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了“毁林压力”指数，认为它有助于保护区规划，可与目前用于备选地点的物种分布信息配合使用。对于任一地点而言，该指数值与栖息地受到的威胁相关，因而也与依赖该栖息地的物种成员随时间推移的生存概率相关。在没有保护区的情况下面临的威胁，是规划新保护区的关键信息。该指数采用一种回归方法估计，该方法源自一个动态的微观经济土地利用模型，并使用了观测到的森林砍伐在空间和时间上的数据，以及影响土地收益的生物物理和社会经济因素。将估计得到的哥斯达黎加威胁（即砍伐概率）函数应用于相关地点，可得出这些地点毁林压力的相关估计值，用于评估拟议的保护区并提出其他备选地点。

title: Endowments, preferences, technologies and abatement: growth-environment microfoundations
venue: Int. J. Global Environmental Issues (2004) volume 4 number 4: 209-228
abstract: Will economic growth inevitably degrade the environment, throughout development? We present a household-level framework emphasising the trade-off between consumption that causes pollution and pollution-reducing abatement. Our model provides a simple explanation for upward-turning, non-monotonic paths of environmental quality during economic growth. Its innovation yields sufficient conditions that simultaneously address preferences and technologies. With standard preferences, an asymmetric endowment (i.e., at zero income, consumption is also zero but environmental quality is positive) leads low-income households not to abate, and further this condition is sufficient for an environmental Kuznets curve (EKC) for a wide range of abatement technologies. Without such an endowment, however, even strong economies of scale in abatement are, on their own, insufficient for an EKC.
abstract_zh: 经济增长在整个发展过程中是否必然会损害环境？我们提出了一个家庭层面的框架，着重强调导致污染的消费与减排治理之间的权衡。我们的模型为经济增长过程中环境质量呈非单调、向上转折的路径提供了一种简单解释。其创新之处在于给出了同时涉及偏好和技术的充分条件。在标准偏好下，一种非对称的禀赋（即在零收入时，消费也为零，但环境质量为正）会使低收入家庭不进行治理，而且这一条件足以在广泛的减排技术范围内产生环境库兹涅茨曲线（EKC）。然而，若不存在这种禀赋，即使减排存在强烈的规模经济，其本身也不足以产生EKC。

title: Household Production and Environmental Kuznets Curves
abstract: This paper provides a theoretical explanation for the widely debated empirical finding of Environmental Kuznets Curves, i.e., U-shaped relationships between per-capita income and indicators of environmental quality. We present a household-production model in which the degrad- ation of environmental quality is a by-product of household activities. Households can not directly purchase environmental quality, but can reduce degradation by substituting more expensive cleaner inputs to production for less costly dirty inputs. If environmental quality is a normal good, one expects substitution towards the less polluting inputs, so that increases in income will increase the quality of the environment. It is shown that this only holds for middle income households. Poorer households spend all income on dirty inputs. When they buy more, as income rises, the pollution also rises. they do not want to substitute, as this would reduce consumption of non-environmental services for environmental amenities that are already abundant. Thus, as income rises from low to middle levels, a U shape can result. Yet an N shape might eventually result, as richer households spend all income on clean inputs. Further substitution possibilities are exhausted. Thus as income rises again pollution rises and environmental quality falls.
abstract_zh: 本文为人均收入与环境质量指标之间呈U形关系这一广受争议的实证发现，提供了理论解释，即环境库兹涅茨曲线。我们提出了一个家庭生产模型，其中环境质量的退化是家庭活动的副产品。家庭不能直接购买环境质量，但可以通过以较昂贵的清洁投入替代较廉价的污染性投入来减少退化。若环境质量是正常商品，人们预期会转向污染较少的投入，因此收入增加将提高环境质量。研究表明，这一结论仅对中等收入家庭成立。较贫困的家庭将全部收入用于污染性投入。随着收入上升，它们购买得更多，污染也随之上升。它们并不想进行替代，因为这将减少对非环境服务的消费，而用于换取本已充裕的环境享受。因此，当收入从低水平上升到中等水平时，可能出现U形。然而，最终可能出现N形，因为较富裕的家庭将全部收入用于清洁投入，进一步替代的可能性已经耗尽。因此，当收入再次上升时，污染上升，环境质量下降。

title: To Err on Humans is not Benign: incentives for adoption of medical error-reporting systems
abstract: Concerns about frequent and harmful medical errors have led policy makers to advocate the creation of a system for medical error reporting. Health providers, fearing that reported information about errors would be used against them under the current medical malpractice system, have been reluctant to participate in such reporting systems.We propose a re-design of the malpractice system – one in which penalties are a function of the health provider’s reporting efforts – to overcome this incentive problem.We also consider some alternatives to this mechanism that address two important ways in which reporting effort may not be observable: hospitals may have interests distinct from individual physicians and may not be able to observe their reporting efforts, and a regulatory agency or a court may not be able to adequately observe reporting efforts by a provider.

title: Carbon dynamics and land-use choices: building a regional-scale, multidisciplinary model
abstract: Policy enabling tropical forests to approach their potential contribution to global-climate-change mitigation requires forecasts of land use and carbon storage on a large scale over long periods. In this paper, we present an integrated modeling methodology that addresses these needs. We model the dynamics of the human land-use system and of C pools contained in each ecosystem, as well as their interactions. The model is national scale, and is currently applied in a preliminary way to Costa Rica using data spanning a period of over fifty years. It combines an ecological process model, parameterized using field and other data, with an economic model, estimated using historical data to ensure a close link to actual behavior. These two models are linked so that ecological conditions affect land-use choices and vice versa. The integrated model predicts land use and its consequences for C storage for policy scenarios. These predictions can be used to create baselines, reward sequestration, and estimate the value in both environmental and economic terms of including C sequestration in tropical forests as part of the efforts to mitigate global climate change. The model can also be used to assess the benefits from costly activities to increase accuracy and thus reduce errors and their societal costs.
abstract_zh: 要使热带森林充分发挥其对减缓全球气候变化的潜在贡献，就需要在较大空间尺度上、较长时期内对土地利用和碳储量进行预测。本文提出了一种满足这些需要的综合建模方法。我们对人类土地利用系统以及每个生态系统中所含碳库的动态进行建模，并考察两者之间的相互作用。该模型为全国尺度，目前以初步形式应用于哥斯达黎加，所用数据跨越五十多年。该模型将一个生态过程模型与一个经济模型相结合：前者利用实地及其他数据进行参数化，后者利用历史数据进行估计，以确保与实际行为紧密相连。两个模型相互连接，使生态条件影响土地利用选择，反之亦然。该综合模型能够针对政策情景预测土地利用及其对碳储存的影响。这些预测可用于建立基线、奖励碳汇，并在环境和经济两方面估算将热带森林的碳封存纳入减缓全球气候变化努力所具有的价值。该模型还可用于评估那些成本高昂的活动所带来的收益，这些活动旨在提高准确性，从而减少误差及其社会成本。

title: Integrity and Isolation of Costa Rica’s National Parks and Biological Reserves: examining the dynamics of land-cover change
abstract: The transformation and degradation of tropical forest is thought to be the primary driving force in the loss of biodiversity worldwide. Developing countries are trying to counter act this massive lost of biodiversity by implementing national parks and biological reserves. Costa Rica is no exception to this rule. National development strategies in Costa Rica, since the early 1970s, have involved the creation of several National Parks and Biological Reserves. This has led to monitoring the integrity of and interactions between these protected areas. Key questions include: ‘‘Are these areas’ boundaries respected?’’; ‘‘Do they create a functioning network?’’; and ‘‘Are they effective conservation tools?’’. This paper quantifies deforestation and secondary growth trends within and around protected areas between 1960 and 1997. We find that inside of national parks and biological reserves, deforestation rates were negligible. For areas outside of National Parks and Biological reserves we report that for 1-km buffer zones around such protected areas, there is a net forest gain for the 1987/1997 time period. Thus, it appears that to this point the boundaries of protected areas are respected. However, in the 10-km buffer zones we find significant forest loss for all study periods. This suggests that increasing isolation of protected areas may prevent them from functioning as an effective network.
abstract_zh: 热带森林的转化与退化被认为是全球生物多样性丧失的主要驱动力。发展中国家正试图通过设立国家公园和生物保护区来遏制这一严重的生物多样性流失。哥斯达黎加也不例外。自20世纪70年代初以来，哥斯达黎加的国家发展战略就包括设立多个国家公园和生物保护区。这促使人们开始监测这些保护区的完整性以及它们之间的相互关系。关键问题包括：“这些区域的边界是否得到尊重？”“它们是否形成了一个运作良好的网络？”以及“它们是否是有效的保护工具？”本文量化了1960至1997年间保护区内外的毁林与次生林生长趋势。我们发现，在国家公园和生物保护区内部，毁林率可以忽略不计。而对于国家公园和生物保护区以外的区域，我们报告称，在这些保护区周围1公里的缓冲区内，1987至1997年期间出现了净森林增长。因此，至今看来，保护区的边界似乎得到了尊重。然而，在10公里的缓冲区内，我们发现所有研究时期都存在显著的森林损失。这表明，保护区日益孤立，可能使其无法作为一个有效的网络发挥作用。

title: Fuel-choice and indoor air quality: a household-level perspective on economic growth and the environment
abstract: The fuel-use decisions of households in developing economies, because they directly influence the level of indoor air quality that these households enjoy (with its attendant health effects), provide a natural arena for empirically assessing latent preferences towards the environment and how these evolve with increases in income. Such an assessment is critical for a better understanding of the likely effects of aggregate economic growth on the environment. Using household data from Pakistan we estimate Engel curves for traditional (dirty) and modern (clean) fuels. Our results provide empirical support for a household production framework in which non-monotonic environmental Engel curves can arise quite naturally. Under plausible assumptions about the emissions implied by fuel use, our estimates yield an inverted-U relationship between indoor air pollution and income, mirroring the environmental Kuznets curves that have been documented using aggregate data. We then demonstrate, through a simple voting model, that this household-choice framework can generate aggregate EKCs even in a multi-agent setting with heterogeneous households and purely external environmental effects.
abstract_zh: 发展中经济体家庭的燃料使用决策直接影响这些家庭所享有的室内空气质量水平（及其带来的健康效应），因此为实证评估人们对环境的潜在偏好及其如何随收入增长而演变提供了天然的研究场景。这一评估对于更好地理解总体经济增长对环境可能产生的影响至关重要。利用巴基斯坦的家庭数据，我们估计了传统（高污染）燃料和现代（清洁）燃料的恩格尔曲线。我们的结果为一种家庭生产框架提供了实证支持，在该框架下，非单调的环境恩格尔曲线可以自然地出现。在关于燃料使用所隐含排放量的合理假设下，我们的估计得出室内空气污染与收入之间呈倒U形关系，这与基于总量数据记录的环境库兹涅茨曲线相吻合。随后，我们通过一个简单的投票模型证明，即使在存在异质性家庭和纯粹外部性环境影响的多主体环境中，这一家庭选择框架也能够产生总量层面的环境库兹涅茨曲线。

title: Effective & Equitable Dissemination of Seasonal-to-Interannual Climate Forecasts: policy implications from the Peruvian fishery during El Nino 1997-98
abstract: The development of seasonal-to-interannual climate predictions has spurred widespread claims that the dissemination of such forecasts will yield benefits for society. Based on the use as well as non-use of forecasts in the Peruvian fishery during the 1997–98 El Niño event, we identify: (1) potential constraints on the realization of benefits, such as limited access to and understanding of information, and unintended reactions; (2) the need for an appropriately detailed definition of societal benefit, considering whose welfare counts as a benefit among groups such as labor, industry, consumers, citizens of different regions, and future generations. We argue that consideration of who benefits, and an understanding of potential socioeconomic constraints and how they might be addressed, should be brought to bear on forecast dissemination choices. We conclude with examples of relevant dissemination choices made using this process.
abstract_zh: 季节到年际气候预测的发展引发了广泛的论断，认为此类预测的传播将为社会带来益处。基于1997–98年厄尔尼诺事件期间秘鲁渔业对预测的使用与未使用情况，我们识别出：（1）实现收益的潜在约束，例如获取和理解信息的途径有限，以及非预期反应；（2）需要对社会效益进行适当细致的界定，即考虑劳动者、产业、消费者、不同地区的公民以及后代等群体中，谁的福利应被计为收益。我们认为，在预测传播的选择中，应当考虑谁从中受益，理解潜在的社会经济约束及其可能的应对方式。最后，我们给出了运用这一过程做出的相关传播选择的若干示例。

title: Generating Probabilities in Support of Societal Decision Making: the case of abrupt climate change
abstract: Earth-science predictions of natural phenomena are increasingly seen as valuable aids to improved societal decision making. Pielke et al. recently (EOS 7/13/99) argued persuasively that good predictions alone won’t achieve better societal decisions. These authors’ call to change the decision environments in which scientific predictions are used, though, may be more relevant to the daily activities of policy makers than to those of scientists. We see a role also for changing the information that scientists feed into those decision environments. In particular, scientists could better serve societal needs by generating not only possible scenarios, but also improved probabilities that decision makers need, including for decisions to be taken in the near future.
abstract_zh: 地球科学对自然现象的预测日益被视为改善社会决策的宝贵辅助工具。Pielke等人最近（EOS，1999年7月13日）有力地论证了仅有良好的预测并不能实现更好的社会决策。然而，这些作者关于改变科学预测所处决策环境的呼吁，可能与政策制定者的日常活动更为相关，而非与科学家的工作相关。我们认为，科学家还应改变其输入这些决策环境的信息。具体而言，科学家不仅可以生成可能的情景，还可以生成决策者所需的、改进的概率，包括用于近期将做出的决策的概率，从而更好地服务于社会需求。

title: How Can Carbon Sequestration in Tropical Forests Be Rewarded? Evidence from Case Of Costa Rica
venue: Central America Project, Environment: Conservation and Competitiveness. HIID 2001. Chapter 14
abstract: The chapter is structured as follows. First, below, we begin this analysis of the process influencing land changes with a dynamic model of land-use choices. Such models have often been suggested, but crucial features have often been neglected in application. This model generates testable hypotheses regarding factors underlying patterns of land-use changes in tropical areas. The next section describes the data collected for this project and discusses the quality of land-use data. It also outlines the variables used to test the implications of the model. Following that, we present our results and then discuss the linkage from land-use changes to implied carbon sequestration, and the quality of information currently available on carbon sequestration. Finally, we present some conclusions and lessons learned.
abstract_zh: 本章结构如下。首先，我们以一个动态土地利用选择模型开始对土地变化过程影响因素的分析。此类模型经常被提出，但其关键特征在应用中常常被忽略。该模型生成了关于热带地区土地利用变化模式背后因素的可检验假说。下一节描述了为本项目收集的数据，并讨论了土地利用数据的质量，同时概述了用于检验模型含义的变量。随后，我们给出结果，并讨论从土地利用变化到隐含碳汇的联系，以及当前可获得的碳汇信息质量。最后，我们给出一些结论与经验教训。

title: The Dynamics of Deforestation and the Supply of Carbon Sequestration: Illustrative Results from Costa Rica
venue: Central America Project, Environment: Conservation and Competitiveness. HIID 2001. Chapter 15
abstract: In this chapter we consider potential gains derived from preventing deforestation, drawing heavily from information from Chapter 14. It uses the same economic model and econometric technique and the same land use/land cover data. It also uses the carbon stock estimates presented there. The key difference is that, instead of using proxies for land-use returns such as ecological characteristics related to higher productivity, we attempt to directly estimate dollar-valued returns. We use these as an independent variable to explain and predict deforestation patterns. This allows us to simulate the potential supply of carbon sequestration in response to dollar-valued returns for certified emissions reductions. Payments for CERs will reduce deforestation by lowering the net return from forest clearing. The loss of the reward for carbon sequestration will partially offset the positive return from agricultural uses. To estimate the effect of such payments on deforestation, and hence CER supply, we need to estimate the response of deforestation to changes in returns to land use. An increase in agricultural returns is empirically equivalent to a reduction in carbon CER payments. Thus, we construct a variable that estimates the potential return of a plot of land if it is cleared. We construct a variable that varies across space (different crop suitability and yields) and time (changes in export prices, technology, and labor costs). We then use this variable in our econometric estimation. The results are used to calculate a supply curve of CERs. These results are illustrative only. They are produced as part of an ongoing effort at estimation (Kerr, Pfaff, Hughes et al. 2000) and are used to show some underlying features of a dynamic supply curve.
abstract_zh: 本章考虑了防止毁林所带来的潜在收益，大量借鉴了第14章的信息。本章使用了相同的经济模型、计量方法以及相同的土地利用/土地覆盖数据，并使用了该章给出的碳储量估计。主要区别在于：我们不再使用土地利用回报的代理变量（如与较高生产力相关的生态特征），而是尝试直接估计以美元计价的回报。我们将这些回报作为自变量，用以解释和预测毁林模式。这使我们能够模拟碳汇的潜在供给如何响应以美元计价的认证减排量（CER）回报。对CER的支付将通过降低砍伐森林的净回报来减少毁林。碳汇奖励的损失将部分抵消农业用途的正向回报。为估计此类支付对毁林的影响，进而对CER供给的影响，我们需要估计毁林对土地利用回报变化的反应。农业回报的增加在经验上等价于CER支付的减少。因此，我们构建了一个变量，用以估计土地被砍伐后的潜在回报。该变量在空间（不同的作物适宜性和产量）和时间（出口价格、技术和劳动力成本的变化）上均有变化。随后我们在计量估计中使用该变量。结果被用于计算CER的供给曲线。这些结果仅供说明之用。它们是正在进行的估计工作的一部分（Kerr, Pfaff, Hughes et al. 2000），用于展示动态供给曲线的一些基本特征。

title: Environmental Self-Auditing: setting the proper incentives for discovery and correction of environmental harm
venue: Journal of Law, Economics & Organization (2000) volume 16 number 1: 189-208
abstract: Many firms conduct 'environmental audits' to test compliance with a complex array of environmental regulations. Commentators suggest, however, that self-auditing is not as common as it should be, because firms fear that what they find will be used against them. This article analyzes self-auditing as a two-tiered incentive problem involving incentives both to test for and to effect compliance. After demonstrating the inadequacy of conventional remedies, we show that incentives can be properly aligned by conditioning fines on firms' investigative effort. In practice, however, the regulator may not be able to observe such effort. Accordingly, we propose and evaluate the use of three observable proxies for self-investigation: the manner in which the regulator detected the violation; the firm's own disclosure of violations; and the firm's observed corrective actions. Each method has its own efficiency benefits and informational requirements, and each is distinct from EPA's current audit policy.
abstract_zh: 许多企业进行“环境审计”，以检验自身对一系列复杂环境法规的合规情况。然而，评论人士指出，自我审计的普遍程度并不如应有的那样高，因为企业担心其发现的问题会被用于对付自己。本文将自我审计视为一个两层级的激励问题，涉及检测合规与促成合规两方面的激励。在论证了常规补救措施的不足之后，我们表明，通过使罚款取决于企业的调查努力程度，可以恰当地调整激励。然而在实践中，监管者可能无法观察到此类努力。因此，我们提出并评估了三种可观察的自我调查代理指标：监管者发现违规行为的方式；企业自身对违规行为的披露；以及企业可观察到的纠正行动。每种方法各有其效率优势和信息要求，且每种方法都不同于美国环保署（EPA）目前的审计政策。

title: From Deforestation to Reforestation in New England, USA
venue: The Forest in the South and North in the Context of Global Warming (book by WIDER)
abstract: Historical data from the late 19th to the early 20th century are examined for New England. From the attempt to explain the reforestation that occurred, three main land-use claims arise: 1) population clearly does not fully dictate land use (e.g., de- or re-forestation); while population may well have an independent effect on land use, that effect clearly does not dominate all others; 2) factors that affect relative land-use returns, whether “external” to a region or not, clearly do affect land use; two examples are transport costs and productivity of other regions, which affect trade; and finally, 3) long-run analysis must consider shifts even in overall framework, such as from agriculture to migration and industrialization processes involving different economic dynamics. Support for these claims comes from limited historical data alongside relevant theory concerning optimal allocation of land between the four most relevant land uses: agriculture, manufacturing, forest (for timber or as a result of abandonment), and shelter (or, more generally, land uses other than for production). Supporting the “population” claim, previous New England farm expansion flattened out post-1850 and eventual reversed itself, even as population was increasing. Regarding the “returns” claim, the breakpoint in the 1790-1930 series of within-region measures (based on county-level data) of concentration of population is very clearly at about 1830, precisely the era in which the transportation revolution involving railroads, steamships and canals started to have its effect. Concerning the “long-run” claim, given an interest in land use there are grounds for attention to shifts in regional output, such as towards manufacturing from agriculture, as there is evidence that such shifts involved significant changes, in particular concentration of population within particular counties, along rivers and in particular locations along rivers.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了新英格兰地区19世纪末至20世纪初的历史数据。在试图解释所发生的再造林现象时，提出了三个主要的土地利用论断：1）人口显然并不能完全决定土地利用（例如，毁林或再造林）；虽然人口可能对土地利用具有独立影响，但该影响显然并不支配所有其他因素；2）影响相对土地利用回报的因素，无论是否“外部于”某一地区，显然都会影响土地利用；运输成本和其他地区的生产力便是两个例子，它们通过贸易产生作用；最后，3）长期分析必须考虑即使是总体框架的转变，例如从农业向迁移及工业化过程的转变，这些过程涉及不同的经济动态。上述论断的支持来自有限的历史数据，以及关于在四种最相关土地用途之间最优配置土地的相关理论：农业、制造业、森林（用于木材或因弃耕而形成），以及住所（或更广义上的非生产性土地用途）。为支持“人口”论断，新英格兰的农场扩张在1850年后趋于平缓并最终逆转，尽管人口仍在增长。关于“回报”论断，基于县级数据构建的1790–1930年区域内人口集中度序列，其断点非常明显地位于约1830年，恰好是铁路、蒸汽船和运河的交通革命开始发挥作用的时期。关于“长期”论断，考虑到对土地利用的关注，有理由关注区域产出的转变，例如从农业转向制造业，因为有证据表明，这类转变涉及重大变化，特别是人口在特定县内、沿河流以及河流沿岸特定地点的集中。

title: The Kyoto Protocol & Payments for Tropical Forest: An Interdisciplinary Method for Estimating Carbon-Offset Supply and Increasing the Feasibility of a Carbon Market under the CDM
abstract: Protecting tropical forests under the Clean Development Mechanism (CDM) could reduce the cost of emissions limitations set in Kyoto. However, while society must soon decide whether or not to use tropical forest-based offsets, evidence regarding tropical carbon sinks is sparse. This paper presents a general method for constructing an integrated model (based on detailed historical, remote sensing and field data) that can produce land-use and carbon baselines, predict carbon sequestration supply to a carbon-offsets market and also help to evaluate optimal market rules. Creating such integrated models requires close collaboration between social and natural scientists. Our project combines varied disciplinary expertise (in economics, ecology and geography) with local knowledge in order to create high-quality, empirically grounded, integrated models for Costa Rica.
abstract_zh: 在清洁发展机制（CDM）下保护热带森林，可以降低京都议定书所设定的排放限制成本。然而，尽管社会必须尽快决定是否使用热带森林类的碳抵消，关于热带碳汇的证据却很稀少。本文提出了一种通用方法，用于构建综合模型（基于详细的历史数据、遥感数据和实地数据），该模型能够生成土地利用和碳基线，预测碳汇向碳抵消市场的供给，并有助于评估最优市场规则。构建此类综合模型需要社会科学家与自然科学家的密切合作。我们的项目结合了多学科的专业知识（经济学、生态学和地理学）与当地知识，以为哥斯达黎加构建高质量、以经验为基础的综合模型。

title: What Drives Deforestation in the Brazilian Amazon? Evidence from Satellite and Socioeconomic Data
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management 1999 volumne 37, pp. 26-43
abstract: This paper analyzes the determinants of deforestation in the Brazilian Amazon. From a model of optimal use, it derives and then estimates a deforestation equation on county-level data for the period 1978 to 1988. The data include a deforestation measure from satellite images, which is a great advance in that it allows improved within-county analysis. Evidence exists that: increased road density in a county leads to more deforestation in that county and in neighboring counties; development projects were associated with deforestation in the 1970s but not in the 1980s; greater distance from markets south of the Amazon leads to less deforestation; and better soil quality leads to more deforestation. The results for government provision of credit are mixed across specifications. The population density, although the primary explanatory variable in most previous empirical work, does not have a significant effect when all the variables motivated within the model are included. However, a quadratic specification yields a more robust population result: the first few people entering an empty county have significantly more impact than the same number of people added to a densely populated county. This result suggests the importance of the spatial distribution of population.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了巴西亚马孙地区毁林的决定因素。基于一个最优利用模型，本文推导并估计了一个以1978至1988年县级数据为基础的毁林方程。数据中包含一项基于卫星影像测得的毁林指标，这是一项重大进步，因为它使得县内层面的分析得以改进。证据表明：一个县的道路密度增加会导致该县及相邻县的毁林增加；20世纪70年代的开发项目与毁林相关，而80年代则不然；与亚马孙以南市场距离越远，毁林越少；土壤质量越好，毁林越多。政府信贷供给的结果在不同设定下并不一致。人口密度虽然是以往大多数实证研究中的主要解释变量，但在纳入模型所推导出的所有变量后，其影响并不显著。然而，二次设定给出了更为稳健的人口结果：在一个空县中进入的最初几人，对毁林的影响显著大于同等数量的人口加入一个人口稠密的县。这一结果表明了人口空间分布的重要性。

Cost-effective climate mitigation via conservation incentives targeting poverty: Bolsa Verde's impact in Brazilian Amazonia settlements
abstract: Conservation incentives have been implemented globally to support forests and the ecosystem services they provide (e.g., greenhouse-gas sequestration). Paying forest managers can increase local acceptance of conservation, while also targeting local poverty. Evidence shows that the impacts of incentives vary across contexts and scheme designs, from zero to high. We assess whether deforestation is avoided in sites where households enrolled in Bolsa Verde, a Brazilian governmental conservation program implemented between 2011 and 2018. For enrolled settlements in Amazonia, we estimate that Bolsa Verde reduced deforestation by a total of ~80’000 ha, implying 35 megatons fewer CO2 emissions over the program’s duration and with no evidence of a rebound in forest loss after the program. We find no evidence of avoided deforestation in other program sites – either settlements outside Amazonia or protected areas inside or outside Amazonia. Still, the monetized value of the climate-mitigation benefits for settlements in Amazonia only may well exceed the program’s cost across all its regions.
abstract_zh: 保护激励措施已在全球范围内实施，以支持森林及其所提供的生态系统服务（例如温室气体固碳）。向森林管理者支付费用，可以提高当地社区对保护的接受度，同时也能瞄准当地的贫困问题。证据表明，激励措施的影响因背景和方案设计的不同而有所差异，从零到很高不等。我们评估了参与“绿色博尔萨”（Bolsa Verde）计划的家庭所在地是否避免了毁林，该计划是巴西政府于2011年至2018年间实施的一项保护计划。对于亚马孙地区参与计划的定居点，我们估计绿色博尔萨计划共减少毁林约8万公顷，相当于在计划期间少排放3500万吨CO2，而且在计划结束后没有森林损失反弹的证据。我们在其他计划地点——无论是亚马孙以外的定居点，还是亚马孙内外的保护区——均未发现避免毁林的证据。尽管如此，仅就亚马孙地区定居点而言，其气候减缓效益的货币化价值可能超过该计划在所有地区的总成本。
